raw.title: Director of Engineering - Customer Workflows
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin’s Engineering org has grown rapidly to more than 150 engineers across multiple tribes, and we are continuing to expand.

AI sits at the centre of what we ship to customers and of how our teams design, build and release software. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to set the technical vision and lead multiple high-impact teams responsible for our Customer Workflows area: the AI-powered workflows our customers use every day to do their jobs in global credit markets.

This role requires a deeply technical, AI-first leader who owns delivery end to end and understands how engineering drives the commercial success of the business. You will lead by example, establishing a culture of engineering excellence where teams tackle complex challenges, innovate boldly, and grow their skills.

We are looking for an experienced leader who has built and shipped AI products that end users rely on. You will help define architecture, set direction for the area, and inspire and empower leaders and ICs to deliver at scale, while staying close enough to the details to review a design, debug a hard problem or pick up the code yourself if it matters.

As Director for Customer Workflows, your role is to amplify the impact of your teams, making strategic decisions that shape the long-term direction of the area. You will ensure reliability, enable rapid innovation, and create the conditions for lasting technical and cultural impact. You'll help shape how a 150+ person engineering org works in an AI-native way, and you'll be measured on what reaches customers and what it does for the business.

Customer Workflows: This is our most customer-facing engineering area. Our customers don’t want another dashboard; they want their work done faster and better. Customer Workflows builds the AI-driven products that make that happen, from the first prototype through to production at scale.

Your customers are the credit professionals using 9fin daily, and the Product, Design and Commercial partners who build alongside you. Your job is to turn their real workflows into products people rely on. That takes a product mindset (know who you serve, prioritise ruthlessly, measure adoption and impact) and deep engineering rigour (reliable, observable, secure AI systems that hold up in production) in equal measure.

 

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s a dose of the kind of things you’ll be doing:

  • Provide strategic & technical leadership over multiple teams in the Customer Workflows area, ensuring alignment with company objectives and technical direction.

  • Lead, coach and inspire Engineering Leads, and grow them and your ICs into stronger leaders with wider technical reach.

  • Set the long-term technical vision for AI workflow products, driving architectural decisions on LLM-powered systems, evaluation, orchestration and the product surfaces customers touch.

  • Stay hands-on where it counts: go deep on designs, reviews, incidents and hard technical trade-offs, and set the bar by doing, not just directing.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Commercial and Customer teams to understand how your area drives revenue and retention, and prioritise the work that moves the business.

  • Work closely with the Head of AI and other Engineering leaders to align technical direction, share expertise and deliver successful outcomes.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence through mentorship, standard-setting, and championing robust engineering practices across teams.

  • Own hiring for your area, partnering with the VP Engineering and our People and Talent teams to build strong, AI-fluent teams.

  • Own delivery for the area end to end: set commitments with Product, track them, and be accountable for outcomes across large cross-team programmes.

  • Oversee technical operations and incident response practices across teams, ensuring high system reliability and actionable learning from incidents.

  • Identify and drive systemic improvements to engineering velocity, quality and security, building security in from the start and adopting tooling, including AI, where it measurably helps teams ship faster and safer.

 

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Are a deeply technical engineering leader with a software development background, with a track record of leading multiple teams and managers in complex, high-growth environments.

  • Technical in practice: Earn technical credibility with senior engineers: you review designs in depth, challenge architecture constructively, and can still get hands-on when needed.

  • Have built and shipped AI products that end users interact with, and can speak in detail about the architecture, trade-offs and results.

  • Are AI-first in practice: you can describe concretely how you use AI in your own day-to-day work, how you’ve changed the way your teams build with it, and the impact on delivery.

  • Combine people leadership with technical depth. You inspire Engineering Leads, lead by example and earn credibility through the quality of your thinking.

  • Think commercially and with a product mindset: you understand how your work drives revenue and retention, and you balance customer experience, architecture and resilience accordingly.

  • Have defined, owned and executed technical strategy, scaled systems, and tied engineering investment to business outcomes.

  • Lead with empathy, communicate clearly and influence across engineering, product, design, commercial and executive leadership.

  • Develop senior engineering talent, build succession plans, and create an inclusive environment where leaders grow their impact.

  • Are judged on impact and ownership, not headcount. You’ve scaled alongside a business and stayed close to the technical work as you did.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

We’re hiring a Security Engineering Lead to build and lead our security engineering team, reporting to the Head of Platform.

You’ll manage engineers working across product and platform security, set a clear direction for the function and help us grow our product security capability. You’ll join a small team with both specialisms already represented and shape how it develops.

Our product security engineers work alongside Product Engineering teams, contributing to planning, design, code and delivery. They report to you for technical development, performance and career progression. You’ll stay close enough to their work to support them well, even when you are not part of their day-to-day team.

You’ll bring experience as a security engineer and as a people manager. You should be able to challenge a design, reason through a threat model and help an engineer find a practical solution. You’ll also need to make choices about where we invest, build relationships across engineering and explain security priorities in terms of customer and business risk.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our product and platform security engineers through regular feedback, coaching, clear expectations and fair performance assessment.

  • Build a focused security engineering strategy and roadmap, informed by our products, engineering plans and the risks that matter most.

  • Grow the team thoughtfully, identifying capability gaps and taking responsibility for hiring and onboarding.

  • Agree sustained product security placements with engineering leaders, with clear priorities, useful feedback and a strong connection to the security team.

  • Help teams build security into architecture and implementation, including access control, tenant isolation, confidential data handling and AI systems.

  • Work with Platform Engineering to make secure infrastructure and delivery practices easy to adopt, using shared controls and automation where they help.

  • Stay involved in important technical decisions through design and code reviews, investigations and selective implementation.

  • Help engineers raise concerns and resolve disagreements constructively. Make material risks and trade-offs clear to the leaders accountable for the decision.

  • Partner with IT and Information Security on shared risks, incident response and assurance requirements.

  • Measure whether our approach reduces meaningful risk and helps engineers deliver securely. Use what we learn to improve it.


What we’re looking for

  • A background in hands-on security engineering, with strong product or application security experience.

  • Demonstrated line management experience: developing engineers, giving difficult feedback, assessing performance and supporting career progression.

  • Experience supporting engineers whose daily work happens within other teams, or comparable evidence of managing effectively without observing all their work directly.

  • Current technical judgement across secure software design, threat modelling, authentication, authorisation and protection of sensitive data.

  • Enough cloud and platform security breadth to guide specialists and make sound decisions across both areas.

  • Experience setting priorities and securing support for security improvements across engineering teams.

  • The ability to explain risk clearly, offer workable options and make proportionate recommendations under uncertainty.

  • A collaborative approach that helps product and platform engineers own the security of the systems they build.

You should be comfortable reading and reviewing production code and discussing implementation choices. The role combines technical leadership with people management and responsibility for building the function.


Useful experience

  • Working with AWS, backend services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

  • Securing multi-tenant products, confidential customer data or AI-enabled systems.

  • Building or improving a small security engineering team in a growing organisation.

  • Introducing secure patterns or tooling that engineers adopted and continued to use.

We value evidence of sound judgement and useful outcomes. You do not need experience with every technology we use.

What success looks like

During your first months, you’ll understand the team’s strengths, our main risks and how security work gets done. You’ll agree development plans with the engineers and establish clear working relationships with Product Engineering, Platform and Information Security.

Over the following months, you’ll put a prioritised roadmap and a workable embedded model in place. Teams should involve security earlier in important decisions, engineers should have useful technical support, and the highest-priority improvements should have clear owners and delivery capacity.

As the function grows, we’ll look for evidence of better protection for customers, adoption of secure engineering practices and a team whose engineers are developing in their roles.

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. raw.title: Director, Strategy & Operations - CEO Office
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The CEO Office works directly with Airwallex’s executive leadership on some of the company’s most important strategic, operational, and organisational priorities.

This is a small, high-trust team responsible for solving complex, company-critical problems across global expansion, product strategy, financial infrastructure, organisational scaling, and AI transformation.

The team helps leadership navigate ambiguity, accelerate execution, and drive alignment across the company during periods of rapid growth and change.

Airwallex is building the global financial infrastructure for modern businesses. With operations spanning multiple continents and rapid growth across payments, banking, software, and AI-enabled financial products, the company is entering a critical phase of global scale and platform expansion.

This role offers close exposure to senior leadership, direct involvement in high-stakes decision-making, and the opportunity to work on some of the hardest scaling challenges inside a global fintech platform.

How you'll make impact

As part of the CEO Office, you’ll shape high-priority strategic, operational, and organisational initiatives that influence Airwallex’s direction globally. You’ll partner with senior leaders to frame complex problems, build alignment, and move initiatives from idea to outcome.

  • Drive work across global expansion, market entry, product and business-line scaling, regulatory and banking infrastructure, organisational effectiveness, commercial acceleration, M&A, and AI-enabled transformation.

  • Connect strategy with execution across Product, Engineering, Finance, Commercial, Legal, Operations, and regional teams.

  • Turn imperfect information into clear decisions, practical plans, and measurable progress in a high-context, high-accountability environment.

  • Build the systems, operating models, and relationships that help Airwallex scale with speed and discipline.

  • Take on increasingly broad leadership responsibility as you develop within the CEO Office.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Proven experience in top-tier consulting, high-growth technology companies, investing, strategic finance, or a similarly high-performance environment.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and driving measurable outcomes.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and structured-thinking skills.

  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex topics clearly and concisely.

  • The ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with high ownership and accountability.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across seniority levels and functions.

  • A high degree of commercial judgment and operational pragmatism.

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.

  • Experience working directly with senior executives or founders.

  • Prior experience in consulting, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or strategic finance.

  • Experience scaling products, markets, or operational functions in international environments.

  • Strong data-analysis and business-modelling capabilities.

  • A demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges, expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise, and are comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone to do it.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

Learn more about your team

Most strategy roles hand you a slide deck. This one hands you the keys.

Strategy & Operations finds the next point of leverage in a hyper-growth fintech, then builds the system to capture it. We spot opportunities early, design how Airwallex scales into them, and turn that vision into the machinery that drives revenue across markets and products.

You'll get the kind of access most people wait a decade for: a direct line to the growth engine, work that spans every function, and the freedom to own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end.

And you won't do it the old way. We arm our people with AI to move faster than teams ten times our size, modeling, researching, and shipping at a pace that creates an unfair advantage.

If you want to do the best work of your career on problems that actually matter, build with us.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

  • Build and maintain regulator- and partner-ready documentation, including obligation mappings, control descriptions, RACIs, testing approaches, evidence standards, and remediation tracking.

  • Engage with EMEA regulators, auditors, and financial partners on control-related inquiries, clearly explaining obligations, control architecture, and how specific controls operate in practice.

  • Support EMEA regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, and related supervisory engagements by coordinating responses, curating consistent evidence packages, maintaining exam-ready documentation, and partnering with Regulatory Compliance and Regulatory Legal.

  • Contribute to the design and operation of EMEA regulatory reporting and obligations governance, ensuring that reporting requirements, ownership, timing, and source systems are clearly defined and appropriately controlled.

  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or duplication across EMEA obligations, controls, and evidence, and drive pragmatic remediation or uplift plans that balance regulatory expectations, partner requirements, and business impact.

  • Help establish consistent obligations-management practices that can scale with Airwallex’s EMEA business and align with the broader global regulatory operating model.

This role is remote in the EMEA region.

What we're looking for

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Essentials

  • 7+ years of experience in regulatory operations, regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management, or a similar discipline within a fast-growing technology company and/or financial services, payments, or fintech company.

  • Direct involvement in supporting regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, or partner due-diligence reviews, with clear personal ownership for planning, coordination, documentation, or remediation workstreams.

  • Strong project management skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional control or reporting initiatives to completion across Product, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

  • Experience with payments, e-money, card issuing or acquiring, treasury, embedded finance, or other multi-jurisdiction fintech business models.

Product Sales is a new team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals to drive adoption of our strategically critical Billing solutions across new and existing Airwallex customers.

You'll use your product, technical, and commercial expertise to enable regional sales teams and help them win. Part product sales, part solution architect, you'll join regional pitches and deals to scope customer requirements and recommend the right technical solution across Subscription Management, Usage-Based Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Payments.

You'll work closely with core sales and account management, marketing, product, and partner teams to build deep product and industry knowledge, and you'll act as the bridge to product and engineering — bringing regional customer needs into the roadmap while continually testing, building, and executing against our go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Enable regional sales teams on Billing — arming them with the pitches, positioning, and technical answers they need to sell with confidence.

  • Partner with account executives on high-value and complex deals, joining customer conversations to scope requirements and recommend the right technical solution.

  • Design solutions that map customer billing needs to our platform, and explain the trade-offs to both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Test market positioning and the appropriate selling motion for Billing products at Airwallex and continue to iterate and improve on them over time..

  • Refine the go-to-market playbook by working closely with Strategy, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing.

  • Provide feedback to Product to inform the development roadmap and commercial priorities.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

  • 3–5 years in product sales, solution architecture, or solution engineering at a technology company, ideally in billing or subscriptions.

  • Technical fluency to talk credibly with product and engineering stakeholders, understand APIs and integration patterns, and recommend sound solutions.

  • Ability to drive the sales cycle in collaboration with existing AE/AM teams, and to translate technical detail into business value for the customer.

  • Evidence of working cross-functionally across multiple stakeholders to drive product or solution adoption.

  • The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.

  • A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.

  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person and online meetings with multiple stakeholders with different backgrounds across finance, product, and engineering.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Background at a billing platform or competitor, for example Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly, or at a billing startup.

  • Alternatively, experience at a technical consulting firm, for example Accenture, Deloitte Digital, or BCG X, designing and selling technical solutions.

  • You are an adaptable specialist, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including CEO, CFO, and CTO.

  • You're used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on complex products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge.

  • You're equally comfortable working with external clients as with internal stakeholders, with a proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.

raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll define and drive the technical strategy for multi-objective payments optimisation, balancing payment conversion, fraud risk and transaction costs. You’ll own complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve payments performance and influence product adoption at scale.

  • Define algorithmic approaches such as contextual bandits, alongside experimentation methods including A/B testing and causal inference.

  • Partner with Engineering to build the tools, infrastructure and production machine-learning systems that enable optimisation at scale.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, Risk and Commercial teams to influence product strategy and investment decisions.

  • Communicate complex data insights and technical recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring your work drives decisions.

  • Mentor and coach data scientists and engineers, raising the bar for technical practice across the team.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • An advanced degree, such as a PhD or master’s, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of industry experience in data science or applied machine learning.

  • Strong experience with experimentation and causal inference to drive data-informed product decisions with measurable impact.

  • Experience operating as a technical leader, defining critical systems and influencing product strategy in a high-growth environment.

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python or R.

  • Experience using LLMs, AI and agents to improve processes or machine-learning models.

Preferred

  • Experience deploying machine-learning systems to production.

  • Experience with payments optimisation, fraud detection, risk modelling or other complex decisioning systems.

  • Experience with contextual bandits or other online optimisation methods.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

Learn more about your team

Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 150+ countries and 60+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. If you want to help scale one of the world's fastest-growing financial platforms safely, this is the team.

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica exists for the half a million or so established SMEs with typically 5 to 100 employees. These SMEs are a crucial pillar of the UK’s prosperity - representing more than a quarter of all turnover and jobs - yet are increasingly neglected by traditional high street banks.

Our Distribution team at Allica have grown rapidly over the last 4 years since the acquisition of the AIB GB UK SME customer portfolio, expanding to give a Relationship Manager presence for established SMEs all across the UK. They are responsible for the development and execution of the commercial strategy for the bank, generating profitable opportunities from supporting our customers.

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in shaping our new offering. The direct asset finance team are early in their journey but are growing all the time, the successful candidate will be as excited as we are to continue building and expanding this offering for established SMEs.

Role Description

Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role will support the delivery of Allica’s Asset Finance product direct to customers. You will deliver a professional relationship management service to customers by providing an exemplary level of customer service to assist in maximising value to Allica, and customers.

You will be the first point of contact for all inbound Asset Finance enquiries and will work closely with a team of locally based Relationship Managers to ensure that all customers receive exemplary service. You will be an expert on all things Allica Bank Asset Finance, feeding back to product teams on how we can improve from customer insights, and making sure that the Relationship Teams are fully up to speed on the latest offerings.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Building and relationship managing a portfolio of Asset Finance customers, driving income in line with monthly, quarterly and annual targets.

  • Handling inbound calls and resolve issues for existing customers.

  • Building and developing your own network of customers, there is an expectation for you to also originate business for the bank yourself through cold out reach and regular networking in your patch.

  • Provide cover and support on Asset Finance to Relationship Managers via telephone and email

  • Roll out targeted marketing campaigns and management of new to bank prospects via telephone and email.

  • Owning the customer service provided to ensure an excellent customer service at all times for all customers, potential customers and professional counterparties.

  • Reporting of Key Business Indicators

  • Identifying Early Warning Indicators and following the correct internal process to manage these.

  • Managing conversations with Credit and appropriate management of customer relationship.

  • Work closely with and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to drive the effective delivery of the Bank’s annual lending budget and ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Establishing and actively managing objectives and a personal development plan.

  • Ensuring your personal conduct and Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) is front and centre in everything that you do.

  • Through a marketing plan, develop and maintain effective relationships with key business Introducers and professional networks

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of proven career progression gained in business development within the Asset Finance market

  • Proven Introducer (non-broker) relationships and relationship management skills

  • Knowledge of Asset Finance products and SME businesses

  • Ability to structure new Asset Finance lending proposals and write credit applications

  • Ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information

  • Knowledge and understanding of CRM

  • Excellent time management and organisation skills to manage multiple workstreams at once.

  • A curious mind, we want colleagues who are keen to find ways to improve and develop our offering through their own experience and regular customer feedback.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

raw.title: Senior Growth Marketing Executive
raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Product Marketing sits within Allica’s Growth function, based around talented, empowered and autonomous individuals who are responsible for driving engagement, retention and growth from our existing customer base across a combination of channels to meet objectives set across the business. You will get the opportunity to work with different teams across the business including product squads, distribution, data and operations to deliver on Allica’s mission of becoming the UK’s most recommended business bank.

We use data to find where customers need us, then apply commercial thinking and creativity to make sure every message and touchpoint is clear, relevant and useful.

We are rare amongst banks in that our senior leadership team have backgrounds at world-leading fintechs, which shows in their active engagement in both the strategic and execution elements of our rapidly scaling organisation. Because we are working on one of the last untapped fintech opportunities, in a small team it will mean that we’re often working on entirely new challenges and unpicking complexity as we move along. No two days are ever the same.

Role Description

We are seeking a Senior Growth Marketing Executive to join our Product Marketing team within Growth. You will help us grow engagement, retention and value from our Business Rewards Account customers - including the lending growth that comes from within that base - by combining sharp analysis with creative, well-executed marketing.

This is a hands-on role that blends data and creativity in equal measure. You will own our monthly product update programme and the campaigns around product and feature launches: making sure customers know what is coming, building interest through warm-up campaigns, and giving them the chance to share their views and feedback. You will grow our engaged customer base and make sure our content drives real engagement with our products, so customers keep moving along the lifecycle stages. You will plan and manage campaigns end-to-end across different channels - email, in-app, push and online banking - using data to understand customer behaviour, target the right customers and prove what worked.

You will help shape the messaging for each launch and manage stakeholders across Product, Data, Compliance, Operations and CRM so roll-outs land smoothly. From 2027 the team's focus widens to post-launch activity and feature adoption based on customer behaviour, and you will contribute by spotting who is under-using a feature and helping design the campaigns that help them get value from it. We also want to re-engage longer-standing customers who have gone quiet and may need reactivating. You will be a natural problem solver who questions assumptions, gets to the root cause and finds practical, scalable fixes. You will join an AI-enabled team, using AI tools day-to-day to move faster on analysis, content and reporting, with the support and space to keep building new skills as the tools and our work evolve.

You will report to the Product Marketing Lead and work closely with the Product Marketing Manager and the wider Growth team. Success looks like a growing, more engaged customer base, strong awareness and uptake of new features, and measurable improvements in reactivation, account usage, retention and cross-sell, delivered through campaigns and experiments you own from idea to live.

Principal Accountabilities

Data & Insight

  • Analyse customer behaviour, campaign performance and engagement trends to find the biggest opportunities to improve feature adoption, usage and retention, and to identify customers who have gone quiet and could be reactivated.

  • Turn analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations, and tell the story in a way that gets the team and senior stakeholders aligned.

  • Maintain regular reporting on in-life performance (engagement, feature adoption, transactions, retention and campaign results), flagging trends and risks early.

Campaign Design & Delivery

  • Own and grow the monthly product update, and plan and run the campaigns around product and feature launches: building awareness of upcoming features, running warm-up campaigns that capture interest, and collecting customer feedback and opinions to feed back into Product.

  • Manage campaigns from brief to post-campaign review: set objectives and audiences, write and build the content, coordinate sign-off and send, and report results against engagement and adoption goals.

  • Design, build, launch and optimise multi-channel lifecycle campaigns across in-app, email, push notifications and online banking, with clear, compelling and on-brand creative.

  • Re-engage and reactivate longer-standing customers who have become inactive or under-use our products, through personalised messaging, nurture journeys and notification frameworks.

  • Use CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot and Customer.io to make sure touchpoints are timely, relevant and personalised, and automate wherever it saves time or improves the customer experience.

Experimentation & Problem Solving

  • Develop and run experiments (for example A/B tests, engagement triggers and new messaging), measure the results and decide what to scale, pause or iterate.

  • Challenge assumptions, get to the root cause of problems and propose creative, scalable solutions.

Collaboration & Customer Insight

  • Work with the Product Marketing Manager and Product Marketing Lead, and with Product, Data, Content, Brand, Compliance, Risk and Operations, to plan and deliver customer engagement initiatives end-to-end, making sure customer communications go through the right review and sign-off.

  • Align with customer-facing teams to share insight, training and tools that improve engagement, and bring customer feedback back into the product roadmap.

  • Use AI-enabled tools to speed up analysis, drafting and reporting, and keep finding new ways to apply them.

Personal Attributes & Experience

We are looking for someone who can clearly show where they have gone the extra mile - a campaign, test or piece of analysis they spotted, owned and delivered that moved the numbers, and how they did it.

Skills & Experience

  • Growth & lifecycle marketing - Demonstrable experience in growth, lifecycle, CRM or product marketing, running campaigns end-to-end and measurably improving engagement, adoption or retention.

raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Bridging Department at Allica Bank is a high-energy, specialist lending team supporting established SMEs and professional property investors with fast, flexible short-term finance. Operating within a true challenger-bank environment, the team combines strong credit discipline with pragmatic decision-making, relationship-led lending, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcomes for customers.

This is a fast-paced and constantly evolving department where no two days are the same. Deals are time-critical, varied, and often bespoke, requiring commercial thinking, sound judgement, and a willingness to take ownership from day one. As the Bridging proposition continues to grow, the role and the department evolve week by week offering genuine variety, exposure, and the opportunity to help shape how the business operates.

The team is lively, proactive, and highly collaborative. People are trusted to act like owners, take responsibility for their decisions, and work closely with colleagues across Distribution, Credit, Operations, and external partners to keep things moving. There is a strong emphasis on keeping things clear and simple, working at pace, and removing unnecessary barriers to getting good deals done without compromising on risk or governance.

Role Description

The purpose of this role is to underwrite larger and more complex borrowing requests across Allica Bank’s Bridging proposition, received via a variety of origination channels. The Senior Underwriter will assess and structure lending proposals in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy, risk appetite, and asset strategy, while supporting the delivery of fast, high-quality outcomes for SME and professional property clients.

The role covers a broad range of asset classes within the Bank’s portfolio, including (but not limited to) residential investment properties, commercial and semi-commercial assets, and refurbishment transactions involving staged drawdowns.

Senior Underwriters are expected to hold a Delegated Lending Authority mandate and to provide oversight and recommendations on approvals, policy exceptions, and escalated cases, including appeals, within their delegated authority. In addition, Senior Underwriters will act as a signatory for cases falling within lower lending mandates.

Underwriters take full ownership of each deal from initial application through to completion. This includes managing and responding to all underwriting and legal requisitions, working closely with brokers, solicitors, valuers, intermediaries, and internal stakeholders to resolve issues efficiently and progress transactions.

As a senior member of the team, the role contributes to the ongoing development of the Bridging proposition, working closely with Relationship Management, Credit Risk, Operations, and other stakeholders to continuously refine processes, appetite, and ways of working in line with Allica’s challenger-bank culture.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assess and underwrite larger and more complex credit applications within personal delegated authority, in line with all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite, and approved underwriting policies, utilising appropriate credit data, financial analysis, and risk assessment tools

  • Produce clear, accurate, and concise written credit papers, providing well-reasoned recommendations to the Credit team for applications falling outside personal discretion or credit policy, and escalating cases as required to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities

  • Undertake regular control checks and ongoing monitoring to ensure the Bank’s risk management, governance, and customer information requirements are always met, escalating immediately any identified issues, breaches, or areas of concern

  • Manage and take full ownership of the end-to-end application process, from initial application through to completion, liaising effectively with brokers, valuers, asset managers, solicitors, and internal stakeholders to ensure appropriate security is in place and all lending is fully documented prior to drawdown.

  • Work closely with the wider team to support effective management of the overall credit risk environment, including portfolio performance, concentration risk, and the ongoing development and refinement of credit policy

  • Liaise effectively with applicants, brokers, valuers, and other third parties to obtain additional information required to support robust and timely credit decision-making

  • Deliver an excellent level of service to customers, brokers, and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong, professional relationships in line with the Bank’s values and customer experience standards

  • Ensure full compliance with all mandatory policies, regulatory requirements, and credit procedures, always maintaining strong internal controls and governance

  • Where applicable, complete monthly assurance and quality assurance dip-testing on cases agreed for direct reports, providing clear feedback, guidance, and development support as required.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • A highly accomplished underwriter with strong experience in manual underwriting within the Bridging sector, demonstrating a deep understanding of the competitive landscape, market dynamics, and evolving trends in short-term property finance

  • Strong credit and financial analysis capability, including the assessment of financial accounts, budgets, and cashflow forecasts, with the confidence to apply sound commercial judgement, make balanced risk decisions within personal discretion

  • Proven experience of confidently escalating complex cases and presenting at Credit Committee, demonstrating accountability, clarity of thought, and ownership of decisions

  • Clear, confident communicator with strong analytical, verbal, and written skills, able to explain risk, structure, and rationale effectively to a wide range of stakeholders

  • Highly organised with excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, able to thrive in a fast-paced, changeable environment

  • A collaborative team player who builds strong, trusted relationships across Distribution, Operations, Credit, and senior management, as well as with external partners including intermediaries, valuers, and solicitors

  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to doing the right thing for customers and the Bank, with a thorough understanding of regulatory requirements, internal policies, procedures, risk controls, and service level expectations

  • Flexible, adaptable, and responsive to business needs, willing to adjust priorities and ways of working to meet SLAs and deliver excellent customer and broker outcomes

  • Established working knowledge of Treating Customers Fairly (TCF), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Conduct Risk

  • Confident user of technology, with experience of CRM systems and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word to support effective analysis, reporting, and decision-making

  • Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s.

raw.title: Head of Security
raw.description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

We're seeking a Head of Security to join our team in London and own the security of Basecamp Research: our data, our models, our locations and our people.

We hold one of the most valuable proprietary biological datasets in the world and the models trained on it, and we operate labs, field expeditions and partnerships across more than 30 countries. Our proprietary data and IP is incredibly powerful therefore we have a duty to our investors, employees, governments and partners to do everything in our power to protect it and use it for positive outcomes. Our security function will take the lead on cyber security and AI safety, and we have strong technical controls across our estate, working with governmental and commercial partners. We now need a new leader to build on our security foundations and develop them into a complete, mature security programme.

This is a hands-on role with a wide remit: cyber and infrastructure security with the platform team, AI and agentic security across the company, and personnel, insider risk, physical and travel security with the People and Operations teams

What you'll own

  • Security strategy. Threat model, roadmap, policies, security culture and reporting to leadership.

  • Cyber and infrastructure security. Vulnerability management, network, cloud and on-prem hardening, supply chain risk, incident response.

  • AI security. Agentic systems, isolated research environments, model and data protection and AI safety risks across the company.

  • People and physical security. Insider risk, personnel security, investigations, threat intelligence, office and lab security, and duty of care for staff in the field.

  • Certifications and providers. Certifications like ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, partner due diligence, and external security vendors.

About you

  • Experience building or leading a security programme against sophisticated, well-resourced adversaries, in government, defence, protective security or a targeted company, with a working knowledge of threat actors and their tactics.

  • Hands-on. You will personally run vulnerability management, review infrastructure designs, lead incident and crisis response and write policy.

  • Strong technical depth across identity, endpoint, network, cloud and on-prem infrastructure and application security, working with engineers and researchers to secure lab and research environments without slowing the science.

  • Experience running training and awareness programmes to foster a positive culture of shared responsibility in relation to personnel, insider risk and physical security that protect IP while remaining proportionate and trusted by staff.

  • You take responsibility for the outcome. If a problem requires learning something new or working outside your usual area, you do it.

  • Discretion, judgement and personal integrity. You will handle sensitive matters that require pragmatism coupled with a strong moral compass. Collaborative and low ego. In a small team everyone depends on what you build.

Nice to have

  • Experience with national security or cybersecurity bodies

  • Experience taking a company through ISO 27001, and familiarity with ISO 42001, ISO 31030 and UK government security frameworks.

  • Experience with the security of ML research environments, AI safety and agentic systems.

  • Experience running travel risk programmes for staff in high-risk locations.

  • Experience in life sciences, including lab environments and regulated data.

What we offer in return

Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics.

Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

Do you want to join our team? Then we'd love to hear from you.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Proven track record delivering complex software product implementations for high-profile customers a huge plus

raw.title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
raw.description:
About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor.

In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence.

We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Applied AI Research at Callosum discovers the methods that make real AI workloads faster, cheaper and better, and turns them into systems that run in production. You will study how agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines and code intelligence stacks actually behave, then invent ways to optimise them at a systems level.

A single optimisation can touch agent and workflow design, context and prompting, model choice, the serving stack and the silicon underneath. So we don't hire specialists in one layer. We hire researchers who can reason across the whole system, from agentic design down to the specifics of the model, and who have a feel for how inference and hardware shape what is possible.

The role is research-led and engineering-heavy. You will need first-principles judgment to see what kind of system a problem needs, the rigour to prove that it works, and the engineering skill to build it yourself.

You will sit across our research and platform functions. What you discover becomes product capability, and what you see in real workloads sets the research agenda. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI Research function as the team scales.

What You'll Work On

Our research tries to construct optimal inference systems from the silicon layer all the way up to the harness: the system will learn from the actual deployment profile and tasks it is used on and optimise itself. Open problems you will own include:

•⁠ ⁠Reverse-engineering agentic systems. Infer the structure of agentic systems from minimal data, and find where it spends compute it doesn't need to.

•⁠ ⁠Routing. Build robust routers that send each request to the cheapest or fastest path that strictly matches or beats the incumbent model on quality.

•⁠ ⁠Proving there is no regression. Design layered proxy evaluations, that bound quality ever more tightly, from coarse checks down to a granular understanding of the system.

•⁠ ⁠New optimisation surface area. Extend the same automatic, detection to new optimisation techniques, and help decide which ones we pursue next.

•⁠ ⁠Research that ships. Run rigorous experiments, write up what you learn, and work with our platform team to turn what works into general product capability.

•⁠ ⁠Shared research infrastructure. Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and experiment tooling the team runs on.

•⁠ ⁠Research judged by production. A result counts when it holds on real workloads. Ideas move quickly from hypothesis to experiment to a deployed system.

•⁠ ⁠Close to real workloads. You work from real production systems and pipelines. Customer contact is scoped: team members who show an aptitude for it can take on more customer-facing technical work, but it is not the core of the role.

•⁠ ⁠Exceptional technical depth, demonstrated through any of: research that shipped, production AI systems at scale, or an early or founding role where you owned the system end to end.

What Sets You Apart

raw.description:

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the Perch camera system, 

Based in London (hybrid), you will work across platform, perception, and ML systems. You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product.

This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. You might have worked on any of the following: high-throughput systems, computer vision, robotics, ML infrastructure, or other complex applications. Our ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, good technical range, and the ability to learn quickly.

You will be hands-on, working in Python and C++ on devices and services in use by our customers every day.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design and implement algorithms for 3D object tracking, segmentation, and motion recognition on embedded hardware.
  • Train and iterate on ML models — from dataset curation through training, evaluation, and deployment to edge devices.
  • Help bring ML, computer vision, or signal-processing systems into production with tight performance constraints
  • Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments.
  • Analyze production data to find system limits, product issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with the embedded platform team on model optimization and inference performance, and with the applications team on how tracking data becomes product features.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience in production systems.
  • Strong skill in Python and backend engineering.
  • Working knowledge of C++ or a strong reason to be effective in performance-critical code.
  • Experience with data-intensive systems, distributed systems, parallel processing, or efficient data pipelines.
  • Exposure to ML, ML infrastructure, signal processing, real-time systems, computer vision, or related applied technical areas.
  • A track record of shipping reliable software, not only prototypes.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to find the root cause of complex system behavior.
  • Clear communication and good judgment when tradeoffs are not simple.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and the desire to learn new technical areas.

Nice to have — and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience with computer vision, depth cameras, pose estimation, tracking, or 3D data.
  • Experience with ML model deployment, feature pipelines, evaluation systems, or data quality tools.
  • Experience with streaming data, event systems, real-time processing, or low-latency applications.
  • Experience with numerical methods, signal processing, filtering, state estimation, or robotics.

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time, you understand the main systems, ship reliable changes, and help improve a meaningful data or product workflow. You give valuable technical input towards solving problems across backend, data, and perception systems.
  • In 12 months time, you have made a measurable impact on system reliability, product capability, or data quality. You own important parts of the architecture and help the team make better technical decisions.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience.   • Lead with a growth mindset, encouraging others to share ideas and opinions.
  • Maintain and enhance software reliability.

  • A proven track record of building applications in C/C++.

  • An aptitude for working with complex data.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
  • A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
  • An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.

  • An understanding of the challenges faced by motorsport officials and teams in managing and participating in events.

  • Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
  • Experience developing applications that process video.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.

That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
  • We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.

Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet!   • 3+ years running IT for a cloud-first company of 50-500 people

  • Strong Microsoft and Google Workspace admin capabilities

  • Scripting and automation

  • Hands-on with AI tools; able to build and run AI agents that do real work

  • Strong documentation and communication skills

  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence

  • SSO/SCIM integrations
