raw.title: Sales Director
raw.description:
Company at a Glance
OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens.

At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

OpenX is seeking a Sales Director to grow our business across Omnicom, including IPG agencies, as part of our EMEA Buyer Development team.

You will own and develop key agency relationships, grow existing partnerships and win new business across display, online video and connected TV. Working with UK and EMEA agency teams, you will help buyers use OpenX’s inventory, curation, audience and performance solutions to meet their clients’ objectives.

We’re looking for someone with an excellent network across Omnicom and IPG, strong programmatic experience and a proven ability to turn relationships into revenue. You should be as comfortable discussing buying strategies with programmatic teams as you are developing commercial partnerships with senior agency leaders.

Key Responsibilities
* Own and deliver revenue targets across your agency portfolio, balancing existing account growth with new business development.
* Build and deepen relationships across Omnicom and IPG, including programmatic, investment, partnerships, planning and client leadership teams.
* Develop and execute account plans that identify opportunities across agencies, advertisers, formats and markets.
* Understand buyers’ commercial priorities, media strategies and technical requirements, translating these into relevant OpenX proposals.
* Grow adoption of OpenX Select, OpenX Build, TV by OpenX and our wider audience and performance solutions.
* Develop opportunities across curation, supply path optimisation, private marketplaces and programmatic guaranteed buying.
* Turn holding company agreements and regional partnerships into agency adoption and sustained advertiser spend.
* Lead pitches, proposals, commercial negotiations and business reviews, bringing in internal specialists where needed.
* Work closely with Account Management, Partnerships, Product, Supply and global commercial teams to support successful activation and long-term account growth.
* Maintain an accurate Salesforce pipeline and revenue forecast, clearly communicating opportunities, risks and next steps.
* Represent OpenX at agency meetings, industry events and networking opportunities.

Required Qualifications & Skills
* 7+ years of experience in digital advertising or advertising technology, with a strong background in programmatic and agency sales.
* An established, active network across Omnicom and IPG, spanning senior decision-makers and the teams responsible for day-to-day programmatic investment.
* A proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets, winning new business and growing strategic agency accounts.
* A clear understanding of SSPs, advertising exchanges and the fundamentals of programmatic buying.
* Experience selling programmatic solutions across display, online video and CTV.
* A consultative sales approach, with the ability to understand a buyer’s needs and build a compelling commercial proposal.
* Confidence explaining technical products clearly and connecting their capabilities to advertiser objectives.
* Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with credibility at both practitioner and senior leadership level.
* Ability to take full ownership of a book of business, leading key buyer relationships and driving account growth.
* A collaborative approach and experience working across commercial, partnerships, technical and operational teams.
* Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, with regular time in the London office and at client meetings.

Desired Qualifications & Skills
* Experience working with regional or global agency hubs and coordinating opportunities across EMEA markets.
* An understanding of how holding company partnerships influence local agency buying decisions.
OpenX VALUES
Our five company values form a solid bedrock serving to define us as a group and guide the company. Our values remind us that how we do things often matters as much as what we do.

WE ARE ONE
We are one team. There are no exceptions. We are a group of strong and diverse individuals unified by a shared mission. We embrace challenges and win together as a team. We respect and care about our colleagues and cultivate an inclusive culture

WE ARE CUSTOMER CENTRIC
We innovate on behalf of our customers. We understand, respect, and listen carefully to our customers. We build great products to solve our customers’ problems. We manage our customers’ expectations clearly and honestly. We are a trusted partner to all of our customers - we act with integrity at all times. We care.

OPENX IS OURS
We are all owners of OpenX
We all have a voice to improve OpenX
We stake our personal and professional reputations on the excellence of our work
We are not interested in just "doing our jobs"; we take ownership to drive results

WE ARE AN OPEN BOOK
We understand and respect what each of us does. We are eager to teach and share what we know with others, both internally and externally. We are eager to learn from others and we ask questions internally and externally. 

WE EVOLVE FAST
We take responsible risks and own and learn from our mistakes. We recognize and repeat success. We actively seek out and provide constructive feedback. We adapt quickly and embrace change. We tackle growth and learning with real urgency. We are endlessly curious.

OpenX TRAITS
Our three traits capture what makes a great team member at OpenX.

HUMBLE
Ideal team players are humble and demonstrate integrity. They put the team's success above their own, share credit generously, and value collective achievements. They are self-assured, open to coaching, and committed to continuous learning.

DRIVEN
Ideal team players are results-driven and motivated. They are curious, always seeking more to do, learn, and take on. As proactive problem-solvers, they take initiative without needing external motivation. They continuously think about the next steps and opportunities for improvement.

SMART
Ideal team players are smart and possess the intellectual acumen to understand the complexities of our organization and industry. They are interpersonally intelligent, good communicators, and exemplify sound judgment in their interactions across the company to foster a collaborative environment.

OpenX is committed to equal employment opportunities.
It is a fundamental principle at OpenX not to discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally-recognized basis including, but not limited to: age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, sex, disability, predisposing genetic characteristics, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, gender identity/transgender status, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical condition, and other protected characteristic as established by law.

OpenX Applicant Privacy Policy
Applicants can review our Applicant Privacy Policy at any time by visiting the following link: https://www.openx.com/privacy-center/applicant-privacy-policy/.

raw.title: AI Solutions Engineer - R&D
raw.description:
AI Solutions Engineer - R&D

 

➡️ Do you understand how R&D and engineering teams work, from technical research and technology evaluation through to product development and innovation?

➡️ Have you gone beyond using AI to actually building solutions, integrating APIs, developing agents or automating complex workflows?

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?

 

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.

The brief is simple:

Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.

We’re looking for people who can bring together:

Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability

A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.

We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:

  • R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.

  • Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.

  • Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.

You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.

That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.

You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position in our London, UK office, working 1–2 days in the office and the rest from home.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research and Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead. 

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.

  • Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.

  • Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

  • Make a tangible commercial impact. See your technical work directly influence customer decisions, accelerate opportunities and support enterprise adoption.

  • Help shape our AI capabilities. Work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing real customer requirements into the development of scalable solutions.

  • Join at an exciting stage of growth. Be part of Patsnap's continued investment in agentic AI, enterprise integrations and the evolution of our Solution Consulting function.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to support complex enterprise opportunities across R&D, engineering, product development and innovation.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers, understanding their existing research processes, engineering workflows, systems, data requirements and business challenges.

  • Design, build and demonstrate AI agents, intelligent workflows, integrations and proof-of-concepts using Patsnap's APIs, MCP capabilities, LLMs and other relevant technologies.

  • Translate real-world R&D use cases, such as technology scouting, technical literature analysis, engineering research, competitive intelligence and product innovation, into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • Integrate Patsnap's proprietary intelligence into customer workflows, internal systems and AI applications.

  • Deliver tailored technical demonstrations that clearly communicate how proposed solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.

  • Own proof-of-concept development from initial requirements and solution design through to testing, iteration and customer presentation.

  • Support technical implementation and deployment following signature, collaborating with Product, Engineering and Customer Success where required.

  • Identify opportunities to develop reusable workflows, templates and solution frameworks that can be applied across customers.

  • Share customer insights and technical feedback to help shape Patsnap's future AI capabilities.

  • You won't carry an individual sales quota, but your contribution will be measured through the commercial opportunities you help progress and close.


What We'd Love From You:

There are three equally important parts to this role:

1) R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding

  • Strong understanding of R&D and engineering workflows, including how organisations approach technical research, technology scouting, product development, innovation and technical decision-making.

  • Experience working within or supporting engineering, industrial R&D, manufacturing, technology development or other research-intensive environments.

  • Ability to understand the challenges faced by R&D and engineering teams, including fragmented data, complex research processes, information discovery and opportunities for workflow automation.

  • Confidence engaging with technical stakeholders, understanding their requirements and translating these into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • A background in engineering, technical consulting, industrial technology, scientific software or a related discipline would be advantageous.

2) Customer-Facing Experience

  • Experience working directly with customers or prospects in areas such as pre-sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, consulting or technical delivery.

  • Confidence leading discovery and requirements conversations.

  • Able to explain complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.

  • Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions live.

  • Good commercial judgement: you know when to go deeper technically and when to focus on business value.

3) Hands-On AI Experience

You must already have experience building with AI, not simply using LLMs for everyday productivity.

We care less about whether something reached production and more about whether you have personally built, tested and iterated something that solved a real problem.

That might include:

  • AI agents or agentic workflows

  • LLM-powered applications

  • APIs and integrations

  • MCP

  • RAG or data-driven AI applications

  • Workflow automation

  • Prompt-based systems

  • Rapid prototypes or proof-of-concepts

Comfort with APIs, no-code/low-code tools, data and light scripting such as Python is a strong plus.

Backgrounds That Could Fit

You might currently work as a:

  • Solutions Engineer / Solution Consultant

  • Technical Pre-Sales Consultant

  • Product Manager / Product Owner

  • Technical or Implementation Consultant

  • Business or Product Analyst

  • Scientific Software Consultant

  • Life Sciences Technology Consultant

We’re typically looking for around 3–4 years of relevant professional experience, although the quality and relevance of your experience matters more than an exact number.

Benefits & Perks:

A culture we’re genuinely proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares knowledge, raises standards and celebrates wins properly together. You’ll have plenty of ownership, work with smart people across the business and be encouraged to keep learning and experimenting. AI Solutions Engineer - R&D

 

➡️ Do you understand how R&D and engineering teams work, from technical research and technology evaluation through to product development and innovation?

➡️ Have you gone beyond using AI to actually building solutions, integrating APIs, developing agents or automating complex workflows?

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?

 

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.

The brief is simple:

Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.

We’re looking for people who can bring together:

Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability

A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.

We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:

  • R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.

  • Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.

  • Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.

You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.

That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.

You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.

This is a hybrid position in our London, UK office, working 1–2 days in the office and the rest from home.

With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead. 

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.

  • Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.

  • Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

  • Make a tangible commercial impact. See your technical work directly influence customer decisions, accelerate opportunities and support enterprise adoption.

  • Help shape our AI capabilities. Work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing real customer requirements into the development of scalable solutions.

raw.title: Events Supplier Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role
The Events Supplier Manager owns Perk Events' global supplier relationships and commercial agreements. Suppliers are the venues, hotels, agencies and event services behind every event we sell: venues, hotel groups, DMCs, catering, AV, transport, entertainment and activities. Most of the focus for this role will be on hotels to start, but with room to expand scope as we grow.

Today, most supplier deals are negotiated event by event by our Events Specialists and Customer Success Managers. This role builds the layer above that. You set the global supplier strategy, secure preferred agreements, build supplier relationships and give the team better rates, terms and margin on every event.

This is a global role, split roughly as follows:

  • Supplier strategy and agreements (60%): decide which suppliers we focus on, negotiate preferred agreements and run the supplier programme.

  • Deal support and performance (40%): help the team win and deliver large or complex events with the best rates/terms possible, and track how suppliers perform.

What You’ll Do

Supplier strategy

  • Build and own our preferred supplier programme across our key event markets globally.

  • Decide where we need more supply, using data on what customers ask for and where we lose deals

  • Set clear supplier tiers, with defined benefits for the suppliers that bring us the most business

  • Partner with Perk Supplier Relations team to ensure we have a consistent supplier strategy across transient and Groups/MICE business

Negotiation and agreements

  • Negotiate preferred agreements with venues, hotel groups, DMCs and other suppliers: rates, commission, payment terms, cancellation and attrition terms, and added extras for customers

  • Agree group and room block terms, working with the Hotel Supplier Partnerships team so hotel partners hear from one Perk

  • Manage renewals and renegotiate when terms or volumes change

  • Own contract templates and keep supplier terms consistent

Supporting the team

  • Join negotiations on large or complex events when Events Specialists and CSMs need support

  • Give the team a simple guide to preferred suppliers and the best deal for each type of event

  • Provide training to upskill our Events Specialists and CSMs on supplier negotiation

  • Pass on supplier feedback and market changes (pricing, availability, new venues) to keep the Events team informed

  • Partner with our dedicated Builders squad to shape our product, ensuring that your work with suppliers connects with customer experience in the product

Supplier performance

  • Track each supplier's volume, margin, commission, customer feedback and delivery quality

  • Run regular reviews with top suppliers, provide reporting, feedback and act when quality drops

  • Check new suppliers before we work with them: insurance, licences, financial stability

  • Report on supplier results and opportunities to the Perk Events leadership team

  • Lead Perk Events supplier days, partnering with the Supplier Relations team

Relationships and presence

  • Build long-term relationships with senior contacts at key suppliers

  • Represent Perk Events at industry events, trade shows and supplier visits, with some travel

KPIs

  • Margin and commission earned from suppliers

  • Share of events booked with preferred suppliers

  • Value of savings and extras secured for customers

  • Supplier quality and customer feedback scores

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 to 6+ years in Hotels, MICE, corporate events, hospitality sales, venue sourcing or supplier management

  • Proven record of negotiating commercial agreements with hotels (required), and venues, DMCs or event suppliers (plus)

  • Strong with numbers: comfortable working out margin, commission and the real cost of a deal in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Clear communicator who builds trust with suppliers and colleagues

  • Able to manage many suppliers and deadlines at once, with little supervision

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • Willing to travel to supplier meetings and industry events

Nice to have

  • Experience in an events agency, TMC, hotel sales team or event technology company

  • Salesforce and Cvent experience

  • Event certifications (for example CMP or CMM)

  • Spanish or another European language

  • Strong knowledge of venues and destinations in Europe or North America

What makes you succesfull here?

  • Commercial: you know what a good deal looks like and push for it

  • Relationship-focused: suppliers want to work with you

  • Practical: you build simple processes the team actually uses, you are ready to build a new program from scratch

  • An owner: you take responsibility for supplier results, good and bad

  • Collaborative: you work as one team with Events Specialists, CSMs, Account Managers and Hotel Supplier Partnerships

  • Ready to build: comfortable in a scale-up that moves fast, you are excited to proactively define new processes rather than being given a playbook.

Why Perk Events?

  • Build the supplier programme for a new and growing part of Perk

  • See your work in the numbers: better margin, better rates, happier customers

  • Work alongside Events, Account Management and Hotel Supplier Partnerships as one connected group

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As Senior Finance Business Analyst/Senior Accountant, you will be a strategic member of our Controllership team based in Barcelona. This role sits under the Finance Department and you will be able to apply both your accounting and analysis skills. You will be part of the Trade Team, with whom you will be responsible for reconciling sales and purchases between backend data and the ERP, calculating and verifying the commissions and fees, and reconciling and invoicing supplier monthly data, among other adhoc projects. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoys turning data into strategy.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Perform monthly reconciliations between the operational back-end systems and the accounting ERP (NetSuite) to ensure completeness and accuracy of revenue and COGS.

  • Prepare, review and post monthly journal entries, including revenue and COGS accruals, reclassifications and other accounting adjustments, ensuring accuracy, completeness and compliance with applicable accounting policies.

  • Perform monthly flux analysis across revenue, COGS and relevant balance sheet accounts, investigating significant movements against prior periods, identifying underlying business drivers and providing clear explanations for variances.

  • Investigate discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders (Strategic Finance, Supplier Relationship, Product) to ensure timely resolution.

  • Calculate and review the commissions received from the assigned verticals, and dispute differences if any.

  • Ensure that suppliers within assigned verticals are properly reconciled in NetSuite and that their aging reports are clean and accurate, analyzing open items and clearing accounts and proposing the right treatment for each.

raw.description:
About us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into "The World of Now," enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.

We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers, enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience.

Backed by a world-class group of investors, including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global, Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.

The Role

Our finance team is growing with the business, and we're looking for a Finance Assistant to join us. It's a genuine first step into finance: you'll work across four international territories (UK, Germany, US and Spain), see how a scale-up finance function actually operates, and take real ownership from early on.

You'll be the engine room of our day-to-day finance operations — payables, cash, expenses and collections — while also getting involved in the reporting and analysis work that sits behind it. We'll teach you the systems and the technical detail; what we're looking for is someone who's accurate, curious and happy to ask why something is done the way it is.

We support professional study (ACCA) after successful completion of probation, and this role is designed as a platform to build from - our last Finance Assistant has just been promoted within the team.

This is a key role within the finance team and will report into our Financial Controller.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the global accounts inbox, ensuring emails are prioritised, actioned and responded to promptly

  • Act as a first point of contact for ad hoc finance queries from across the business

  • Process supplier invoices and manage payment runs across our UK, German, US and Spanish entities

  • Credit card and expense management

    • Administer our virtual credit card platform

raw.title: VP Data & AI Platform Engineering
raw.description:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Quantexa’s largest customer engagements are now enterprise platform transformations, and we want to replicate that success across strategic customers globally. We are establishing a dedicated platform function for the first time, and we are looking for a player-manager to lead it. Reporting to the SVP of Data & AI Platform Solutions, you will build and lead a small, senior, global team of platform architects. You will shape how Quantexa takes its Data & AI and Context Layer propositions to market, and you will personally lead support our most strategic pursuits, supporting large platform deployments from early technical engagement and proof of concept through to value realisation and expansion. Success means more platform deals won, larger and faster-moving pursuits, and customers who expand their use of the platform after go-live. That track record is what will earn the team its growth. The role is greenfield: you will define what the function owns, how it works and how it scales within the context of the wider operating model.

What You’ll Be Doing

Win strategic platform deals

  • Lead the technical and business narrative on targeted global accounts, working alongside field engineers and sales.

  • Map the customer’s enterprise ecosystem, uncover high-value use cases and data, build the business case for enterprise platforms and context layer, and take get buy-in from it to the C-suite.

Shape platform propositions and build support for transformational deals

  • Define and sharpen Quantexa’s platform propositions for target industries and buyer personas, drawing on what we learn in live customer engagements.

  • Give technical input to platform market positioning and messaging for the platform and context layer, working with Marketing so that what we say in the market is credible and differentiated.

  • Build the support that transformational deals need: executive narratives, reference architectures, business case materials and proof-of-concept approaches. Make these reusable across accounts.

  • Present the propositions at customer and industry events, as a credible technical voice on enterprise data platforms and agentic AI.

  • Work with the Alliances team, Marketing and Product so that partner and technology-ecosystem conversations reinforce the propositions.

Connect customer needs to platform strategy and the product roadmap

  • Identify the features, capability gaps and needs that customers and deals expose, and use them to inform platform strategy.

  • Define platform requirements and work closely with Product Management to ensure the necessary changes are incorporated into the product roadmap.

  • Test new platform uses, including agentic AI and the Context Layer, with Product Innovation and Delivery, and help turn proven ideas into market validated and technically de-risked features as candidates for introduction into product.

  • Build the demos and integrations that show customers the value.

Build and lead the team

  • Set the direction and standards for a global team of platform architects, and coach and develop them.

  • Launch the team with three new approved roles and use early wins to secure investment for further growth.

  • Shape how the team works with Field Engineering and regional account teams, and where it focuses its effort in line with strategic priorities.

Create a repeatable platform method

  • Own the methodology and toolkit that take a customer from a first use case to wider platform adoption.

  • Work with the Enablement and Marketing teams to enable partners, customers and colleagues to run platform engagements themselves for self-sufficiency in applying best practice approaches for platform and context layer – contributing content and helping coordinate execution.

What you’ll bring?

  • A record of C-suite, business and technical engagement, including running executive workshops.

  • Experience managing and influencing teams of architects and developing senior technical talent.

  • The ability to work with Product and Marketing: you can turn customer needs into clear requirements and explain technical differentiation to a market audience.

  • The agility of a player-manager: you can lead a senior executive meeting in the morning and be hands-on with a design or demo in the afternoon.

  • Broad architecture experience:

  • enterprise architecture, for vision and roadmaps

  • solution architecture, for shaping opportunities

  • data architecture, for designing data products

  • The technical depth to be credible with CTOs, CDOs and Chief Architects on data integration, platform architecture and secure deployment models.

  • Hands-on building experience. You can design systems and have built non-trivial components, ideally with AI coding tools such as Claude.

Nice to have

  • Experience of the Databricks or Snowflake ecosystems, or of hyperscaler data platforms.

  • Experience supporting large programmes delivered with systems integrators.

  • Experience of building a new function or team.

  • Experience in a product-facing role, such as defining requirements or contributing to a roadmap.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

     

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

raw.title: Director, Strategic Intelligence - 1066
raw.description:
We are seeking a Director, Strategic Intelligence. In this role you will lead Quantinuum's strategic intelligence function, providing forward-looking insights on markets, competitors, customers, technology developments, government policy, investment activity, and broader industry dynamics. 

The Director, Strategic Intelligence is responsible for building and operating an enterprise intelligence capability that enables executives to make informed strategic decisions, anticipate market shifts, identify growth opportunities, mitigate external risks, and strengthen Quantinuum's competitive position. The role serves as the central hub for market intelligence, competitive intelligence, technology monitoring, customer insights, and strategic analysis across hardware, software, cybersecurity, AI, quantum applications, and adjacent markets. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership: Own Quantinuum's enterprise strategic intelligence capability and be accountable for delivering actionable market, competitor, customer, technology, policy, and ecosystem insights that inform executive decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and long-term growth priorities. 

  • Competitive Intelligence: Own the continuous assessment of competitor strategies, product developments, customer activity, partnerships, acquisitions, investments, and market positioning and be accountable for providing executives and business leaders with timely intelligence that strengthens Quantinuum's competitive advantage. 

  • Market & Industry Analysis: Own the analysis of market dynamics, customer adoption trends, growth segments, and emerging opportunities and be accountable for producing data-driven recommendations that influence business strategy, investment priorities, and commercial focus areas. 

  • Technology & Innovation Intelligence: Own the monitoring and assessment of developments across quantum computing, AI, cybersecurity, networking, advanced computing, and adjacent technology sectors and be accountable for identifying opportunities, threats, and strategic implications for Quantinuum's technology roadmap and market position. 

  • Government, Policy & Geopolitical Intelligence: Monitor the evaluation of government policy, regulatory developments, national quantum initiatives, public funding activity, export controls, and geopolitical trends and be accountable for ensuring business leaders understand the strategic implications for growth, partnerships, market access, and risk. 

  • Customer & Ecosystem Insights: Own the development of a structured voice-of-market capability and be accountable for synthesising customer, prospect, partner, investor, analyst, and ecosystem feedback into insights that improve strategic decision-making and market responsiveness. 

  • Executive & Board Decision Support: Own the development of strategic briefings, market assessments, scenario analyses, and executive recommendations and be accountable for providing fact-based intelligence that supports high-quality decision-making by the Executive Team and Board. 

  • Strategic Planning Support: Own the integration of market, competitive, customer, and technology intelligence into strategic planning processes and be accountable for ensuring that annual and long-range plans are informed by robust external insight and evidence. 

  • Strategic Opportunity & Risk Identification: Own the identification and assessment of emerging opportunities, disruptions, threats, and competitive risks and be accountable for ensuring executive leaders are equipped to act proactively rather than reactively to market developments. 

Must Haves 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership (10+ years),  Proven experience leading market intelligence, competitive intelligence, strategic planning, corporate strategy, consulting, research, or business intelligence functions in technology, deep-tech, cybersecurity, software, AI, semiconductor, or adjacent industries. 

 

We Value 

  • Competitive & Market Analysis Expertise:  Strong capability in competitor assessment, market analysis, strategic research, industry forecasting, and synthesis of complex external information into actionable business insights. 

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to distil large volumes of technical, commercial, and market information into concise executive-level recommendations and decision-support materials. 

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:  Demonstrated experience conducting structured analysis, scenario planning, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and strategic assessments. 

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Track record of influencing senior leaders and shaping strategic decisions without direct authority. 

  • Experience in quantum computing, advanced computing, AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications, semiconductors, or other frontier technologies.  

  • Experience within a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a high-growth technology company.  

  • Experience supporting executive leadership teams, CEO staff functions, or Boards.  

  • Exposure to government markets, national security environments, and public-sector technology ecosystems.  

  • Familiarity with M&A strategy, venture capital activity, and technology investment landscapes.  

  • Strong data analytics and intelligence tooling capability. 

 

Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

Visit our news pages to learn more about Quantinuum and our scientific breakthroughs and achievements:  https://www.quantinuum.com/news
Quantinuum Intro Video: The Future of Quantum Computing

What’s in it for you?

We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
  • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
  • 28 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
  • 4% employer pension contributions
  • Life Insurance
  • Private medical insurance through Bupa
  • Dental Insurance through Bupa
  • Income Protection
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Contribution to eye care
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. For more information about Quantinuum, please visit our website. 

We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, there is no application deadline for this position.

raw.title: Software Engineering Manager, Billing & Integrations
raw.description:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Billing & Integrations, the team behind usage metering, plans and subscriptions, spend controls, invoices, and selected partner integrations. Your team makes it possible for us to launch billable capabilities and to run routine billing through reliable APIs and tools. You’ll also keep our integrations dependable and current.

Leading a team at Sanity means owning strategy, roadmap, and execution alongside your product partner. This is a player-coach role: most of your time will go to people, priorities, and delivery, while you stay close enough to the code to review designs, unblock difficult problems, and guide technical decisions.

What you will do:

  • Lead delivery of a reliable monetization platform

    • Own the engineering roadmap with Product, balancing new billing capabilities, customer-facing improvements, reliability, and reducing manual work.

    • Guide the usage-to-invoice architecture: metering correctness, subscription lifecycle, reconciliation, and dependable budget and limit enforcement.

    • Turn recurring plan, coupon, credit, and invoicing requests into documented APIs and self-service tools that other teams can operate independently.

  • Coach and develop the engineering team

    • Develop engineers through clear feedback, meaningful ownership, career support, and hiring as the team’s needs evolve.

    • Stay technically engaged through architecture reviews, pairing, and code where it helps the team most; strengthen testing, observability, incident response, and safe migration practices.

  • Partner across Sanity

    • Work with Product, Growth, Finance, RevOps, Support, and engineering teams to make pricing and billing requirements clear, surface trade-offs early, and protect customer trust.

    • Keep existing partner integrations reliable and aligned with upstream API changes. Measure impact through billing accuracy, self-service adoption, commercial lead time, and operational health.


About you:

  • Based in Oslo, Norway, or London, UK.

  • You communicate technical designs and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, with both engineers and non-technical partners.

  • You have proven experience managing engineers and delivering software at a product or SaaS company, backed by a substantial hands-on engineering background.

  • You’ve led backend or platform systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience in billing, payments, usage metering, subscriptions, or entitlements is especially useful.

  • You turn ambiguity into clear priorities, deliver incrementally, and can show how your team’s work improved customer or business outcomes.

  • You care about growing people and building a team with shared ownership. You work effectively across functions and timezones, and replace recurring manual work with reusable capabilities.

  • You can reason deeply about event-driven systems, API contracts, idempotency, retries, consistency, reconciliation, and safe changes to critical state. Familiarity with Orb, Stripe, or Temporal is a plus; transferable engineering judgment matters more than a particular vendor.

Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway!


What we can offer:

  • A highly-skilled, inspiring, and supportive team

  • Positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment that encourages long-term professional and personal growth

  • A global, multi-culturally diverse group of colleagues and customers

  • Comprehensive health plans and perks

  • A healthy work-life balance that accommodates individual and family needs

  • Competitive salary and stock options program

Who we are:

Sanity.io is a modern, flexible content operating system that replaces rigid legacy content management systems. One of our big differentiators is treating content as data so that it can be stored in a single source of truth, but seamlessly adapted and personalized for any channel without extra effort. raw.title: Mid/Senior Backend Engineer - Ruby
raw.description:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

Role Summary:

From efficiently scaling database operations to supporting the growing amount of data (tens of terabytes), we're looking for engineers that have the creativity and skills to gather meaningful data and insights.

As an engineer at Sensor Tower, you will make sure we're building the best possible products and features to support our users. In our lean and flat organization, you will also have a meaningful say in what and how we build out all aspects of our product.

A Day in the Life:

Interviewee: Engineering Team Lead - Sasha Yelkovenka

 

What does your day to day look like working as a Software Engineer?

I work with tons of data and the volume of this data is constantly increasing. My job is to make sure our customers can access it as quickly as possible and provide them convenient tools for data consumption. I love the spirit of taking ownership of your work and product.

 

How do you collaborate with your team as a remote employee?

Sensor Tower has a great atmosphere of a distributed team. We often pair over zoom to combine our knowledge in order to achieve better results..

What You Will Do

  • Participate in the full development life cycle, including design, implementation, quality polish, and release.

  • Leverage your strengths and interests to work on full feature implementation from brainstorming the architecture design, all the way to the back end implementation and delivery to the customers.

  • Optimize endpoints that touch billions of rows in the database, by applying profiling to ruby code and understanding crucial performance details of ClickHouse queries.

  • Perform code reviews, and suggest improvements to tools and processes.

  • Work on challenging products like Top Apps, where each query basically analyzes the whole dataset.

  • Design API contracts that other teams can rely on, and evolve them without breaking existing consumers.

  • Be the go-to partner for front-end, product, data science and customer-facing teams building on these APIs. Understand what they need, push back when a request would make the API harder to reason about, and turn recurring questions into better docs.

Experience We Want To See

  • 3+ years of experience as a software engineer (If you have lesser years of experience but have meaningful github contributions and other coding samples, this will be taken into consideration).

  • Strong foundation in programming, algorithms, and software application design.

  • Good API design for query-heavy, data-intensive APIs.

  • You have an understanding of the basics of cloud environments, and ideally you’ve had some exposure to AWS.

  • Required: Ruby on Rails (or Python and willing to learn Ruby on Rails).

  • Nice to have: Clickhouse, MongoDB, Sidekiq.

  • A track record of independently driving projects from ambiguous requirements to release.

Our Engineering Culture

We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values:

- Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys."

- Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping.

- Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids.

- Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent.

Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team):

https://sensortower.com/blog/speeding-up-the-backend-with-graph-theory

https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers

Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying.

To all recruitment agencies:

Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

This isn’t just a Sales Development role — it’s your chance to be the engine of Sitetracker’s pipeline growth during a high-impact period. As a French-speaking Senior Sales Development Representative, you’ll address the critical business need of generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline in our EMEA region. With increased investment and focus on international expansion, your efforts will directly influence revenue growth and market penetration in this dynamic, fast-paced environment. You’ll be stepping into a role with visibility, autonomy, and the support to shape how Sitetracker connects with prospective customers across London, Spain, and beyond. If you’re driven by the challenge of building scalable outbound strategies and crave the opportunity to make a measurable difference — this is it.


What You’ll Do

As a Senior SDR, you’ll play a pivotal front-line role in Sitetracker’s sales ecosystem. You’ll consistently generate high-quality leads and pipeline through thoughtful, targeted outreach, becoming a true partner to our account executives and a trusted voice to our prospects. This isn’t a “smile and dial” environment — it’s a career-defining opportunity to take ownership of your region and make strategic decisions about where and how we go to market. You’ll collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine messaging, run account-based plays, and experiment with new channels and approaches. Your success will be measured not just by volume, but by the business value of the opportunities you surface. In short, you won’t just be booking meetings — you’ll be driving real, scalable impact.


The Skills You’ll Have


1. Operational Discipline & Consistency

  • Build and follow a consistent daily rhythm to drive pipeline generation and CRM hygiene
  • Use time-blocking and focused outreach methods to hit high-volume targets
  • Demonstrate follow-through on multi-touch outreach campaigns with measurable results
  • Log activity and outcomes meticulously to create visibility and enable coaching
  • Maintain clean Salesforce records and proactively flag blockers or risks

2. Outbound Prospecting Excellence

  • Drive outbound pipeline creation using a mix of phone, email, and social touchpoints
  • Execute persona-driven messaging that resonates across geographies
  • Customize outreach for Tier 1 accounts and apply insights to scale for Tier 2/3
  • Partner with AEs on account strategy to deliver personalized outreach sequences
  • Track and analyze response patterns to iterate and improve outreach effectiveness

3. Resilience & Mindset

  • Maintain momentum and positivity through high-rejection outreach environments
  • Rebound from challenges by leveraging data and coaching for continuous improvement
  • Lean into discomfort and drive impact during uncertain or ambiguous situations
  • Build mental stamina and structure that sustains performance over time

4. Target & KPI Accountability

  • Consistently exceed quota and activity metrics through focused execution
  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and pride in hitting and surpassing goals
  • Adjust approach based on pipeline coverage, conversion trends, and feedback loops
  • Proactively surface opportunities to improve systems, messaging, or workflows

Within 90 Days, You’ll:

  • Ramp to full productivity with a structured, repeatable prospecting rhythm
  • Own outreach for your assigned region and collaborate closely with sales leaders
  • Deliver pipeline against monthly targets with precision and urgency
  • Demonstrate accountability through clean Salesforce tracking and proactive updates
  • Begin influencing team strategy through feedback and performance insights

Within 180 Days, You’ll:

  • Exceed pipeline goals through creative outbound strategies and consistent execution
  • Establish yourself as a trusted partner to your AE and regional sales team
  • Actively contribute to refining messaging, plays, and processes
  • Identify and overcome barriers in specific markets or verticals
  • Take initiative to lead mini-projects or best practice sharing sessions

Within 365 Days, You’ll:

  • Become a bar-raising performer, consistently hitting top quartile performance
  • Influence SDR playbooks and prospecting strategy across EMEA
  • Mentor new hires or contribute to team training and enablement
  • Partner with marketing to align messaging and drive pipeline quality
  • Position yourself for career growth into AE or leadership paths

raw.description:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

We're an AI Health Tech company in the UK and Europe, leading from the front in the AI Diagnostics space.

Our AI Platform, DERM, is the UK’s and Europe’s first autonomous Class III AI as a medical device, certified to the same safety standard as a pacemaker. Independently proven to perform at least as well as a face-to-face dermatologist assessment, our technology is giving millions of people access to a fast and accurate way to detect skin cancer, saving significant time and costs for global healthcare systems and improving outcomes for patients. DERM has been an integrated part of NHS dermatology pathways for over six years and is already in use in 25 NHS Trusts, and trusted by private health providers including Bupa and Vitality. It has assessed over 300,000 patients and found more than 25,000 cancers, validated by histopathology, the diagnostic gold standard.

We are fast growing, raised £15M in series B funding in 2025, and are scaling across Europe - with regulatory approvals underway in other regions. In June 2026, we launched DERM Zero, the world' s first Class III regulated medical device technology to deliver autonomous clinical grade skin cancer assessments from a smartphone, changing the way that people can access clinically validated skin cancer checks.

raw.title: Design Engineer
raw.description:
SpAItial is pioneering Physically-grounded World Models, a new AI paradigm designed to generate and reason about the appearance and physics of real and imagined environments. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the geometry of our world, redefining how industries from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema create and interact with 3D environments.

We are looking for our first Design Engineer to own the design system and product experience across SpAItial's web and mobile surfaces. You will translate the company brand into reusable product patterns, clear interaction models, and production-quality front-end experiences that you can help design and ship.

You will work closely with product engineers to design how people create, explore, and edit 3D worlds across web and mobile. You own product design, interaction models, reusable components, prototypes, and production front-end implementation. This is a hands-on role for someone equally comfortable maintaining a design system, resolving the details of a complex product flow, and shipping high-quality interfaces.

We care far more about the quality and range of your work than where you have worked. Show us design systems you have built, web and mobile products you have shipped, and examples of how your designs held together from concept through implementation.

Responsibilities

  • Brand and design system. Translate SpAItial's brand into practical rules for typography, colour, iconography, layout, components, and interaction across product and company surfaces.

  • Design infrastructure. Own shared Figma libraries, components, variables, templates, and documentation so teams can build consistent experiences without redesigning common patterns.

  • Web product design. Design responsive experiences for world creation, the 3D viewer, editing, onboarding, accounts, and pricing or upgrade surfaces. Work with product engineers from early concepts through polished implementation.

  • Mobile product design. Design clear capture, upload, generation, and viewing journeys for mobile devices, accounting for camera workflows, permissions, progress states, failure recovery, and platform conventions.

  • Spatial interaction. Define how people move through and manipulate generated 3D worlds, including camera behaviour, navigation, selection, editing, and transitions. These interaction patterns are not established yet.

  • Website and company surfaces. Design the marketing site, careers pages, technical documentation, and reusable presentation templates as extensions of the same system used in the product.

  • Front-end implementation. Turn designs and prototypes into production-quality interfaces. Build reusable components, implement responsive behaviour and interaction states, and collaborate with product engineers through review and release.

Key qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in product design, design engineering, digital product design, or a similar role.

  • A strong portfolio that includes a scalable design system and shipped web and mobile product work.

  • Strong systems thinking across typography, layout, colour, components, interaction states, and responsive behaviour.

  • Strong interaction and product-design fundamentals across responsive web and native mobile experiences, including accessibility and platform conventions.

  • Fluency in Figma, including components, variables, prototyping, and design systems that other people can use.

  • Able to write and ship production front-end code using React and TypeScript, or a comparable modern web stack, with strong attention to accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Comfortable working directly with engineers, understanding implementation constraints, reviewing builds, and refining details through release.

  • High ownership and comfort with ambiguity. You will be the first person in this role and will define the design function.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing products involving 3D, spatial computing, cameras, creative tools, or technically complex workflows.

  • Familiarity with Gaussian splats, WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, PlayCanvas, Blender, Unreal, AR, XR, or VR.

  • Experience with 3D web development using Three.js, React Three Fiber, PlayCanvas, WebGL, or similar tools.

  • Experience with native mobile design tooling or production mobile application stacks.

  • Experience building or extending a design system across both product and marketing surfaces.

raw.description:
Senior Manager, Automation & Controls

Location: London (Hybrid)

STACK supports hybrid working, typically combining three office or site-based days per week, subject to business requirements.

Role Summary

As Senior Manager, Automation & Controls, you will provide specialist controls expertise across STACK Infrastructure's Data Centre construction portfolio, supporting the design, coordination, commissioning and delivery of BMS, EPMS and associated network infrastructure. Working closely with Construction, Commissioning, BMS, IT, server teams, consultants, general contractors and controls vendors, you will provide technical oversight throughout project delivery, helping ensure controls systems are coordinated, tested and implemented in line with STACK standards. The role will cover multiple project locations rather than a single site. Regular presence at construction sites will be required for key testing, reviews and meetings, so flexibility to travel between locations as project needs dictate is essential.

This role can be based from Milan, Oslo, London or Geneva

Key Responsibilities

• Provide controls SME support to Construction and other project delivery functions.

• Liaise with STACK BMS and IT teams to facilitate switch and firewall configuration for BMS/EPMS.

• Liaise with STACK server teams to facilitate virtual machine (VM) configuration for BMS/EPMS.

• Undertake high-level reviews of key controls-related design deliverables.

• Assist with the coordination and oversight of SFAT activities and review commissioning test scripts related to controls.

• Maintain a regular site presence during major testing activities, providing an additional layer of scrutiny of BMS/EPMS systems and SME support to the Commissioning team.

• Oversee the close-out of BMS, EPMS and network-related items within the commissioning IRL.

• Engage with the Commissioning Agent, general contractor and vendors to advise on BMS, EPMS and network infrastructure commissioning programmes.

• Contribute to the development and management of controls design standards and oversee their implementation across projects.

• Capture project feedback and lessons learned and feed appropriate updates into controls standards.

• Attend sites as required to conduct progress walks, participate in key meetings and observe controls vendor site acceptance testing.

• Support controls vendors in resolving potential blockers and support vendors with BMS, EPMS and network coordination as required.

• Support the onboarding of controls vendors in line with STACK frameworks.

What You'll Bring

• An HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Experience of controls network and power redundancy design and control panel design.

• Experience writing Sequences of Operation (SoO) and technical specifications.

• Practical knowledge of PLC and SCADA programming.

• Experience with controls hardware and device selection.

• Experience in commissioning management, design management and portfolio management.

• Good knowledge of mechanical and electrical building services.

• Knowledge of open protocols and experience of systems integration.

• Strong communication, technical report writing and presentation skills.

• The ability to track progress and provide clear reporting across multiple projects and stakeholders.

• Flexibility and willingness to travel regularly between multiple project locations as required.

What will make you stand out

• A degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.

• A recognised project management certification.

What We Offer

• Work on critical digital infrastructure, supporting the development and operation of some of the world’s most advanced Data Centre environments.

• Build your career with STACK, gaining exposure to large-scale projects and opportunities to shape delivery across a fast-growing European platform.

• Competitive benefits aligned with our country-specific policies.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world’s most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.
