raw.description:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match 3 Level Designer to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define the game’s level design framework while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with designers, product managers, programmers and analysts to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience and reach product goals

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets the team’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

raw.description:
LOCATION: London, UK preferred. US & EU candidates will be considered. then US, then EU.

Option A: £400-500/day ~2.5 days/week, contract.
Option B: £120,000 base, full-time.

We are open to two profiles:

  • Head of Security (part-time contract, ~2.5 days/week): an information security lead covering the full scope below.

  • Head of Security & Security Engineer (full-time): the same scope, plus hands-on technical security engineering. This is highlighted in the additional engineering scope below.

Please tell us in your application which you are applying for and what your availability and notice period are.

About

The AI Whistleblower Initiative (https://aiwi.org) is an independent non-profit supporting frontier AI insiders who want to raise concerns. We do this through outreach and education of insiders, access to vetted legal and financial resources, and policy work. Our insights help strengthen internal and government reporting channels, advocate for better legislation, and promote the conditions under which concerns can reach the people best placed to act on them, with source protection at their core. Find a selection of our work here (https://aiwi.org/our-work).

Most high-stakes moments in AI over the coming years will involve frontier company insiders having and raising concerns: within companies, to regulators, or through other pathways.

Those insiders tell us they face enormous uncertainty along the “concern raising” path -- from detecting concerns to whether and how to voice concerns with maximum impact and minimal risk, which even legally protected whistleblowing can carry. To date, no organization has dedicated itself deeply to delivering the best strategic, frontier-AI-specific guidance to these individuals, their supporters, and their attorneys (our partners). We exist to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure.

Tasks

About the role

The Head of Security is a dual inward- and outward-facing role. You will update, design and implement AIWI’s internal security posture, and provide external guidance to AI insiders, whistleblowers and partners. You will create and oversee internal security controls, manage an evolving risk appetite, and design internal policies and trainings so that staff stay safe and secure in their everyday workflows. You will also design and deliver training and guidance to would-be whistleblowers and AIWI’s partners.

In other words, you are as comfortable drafting an internal security policy or building an onboarding and device-provisioning plan as you are training whistleblowers on how to evade insider-threat-management (ITM) systems, or explaining natural language watermarking. You can design, implement, and enforce a coherent data governance policy, and you understand the intricacies of watermarking schemes and counter-forensic measures against them.

You will report to Karl Koch, our CEO, and work closely with our co-founder/technical advisor Max and the principal engineer we are hiring. You will manage potential contractors and propose spend, with CEO sign-off on budget. Our environment is highly sensitive: so confidentiality, careful judgement, and conviction in what we do are essential.

Areas of Ownership

1. Internal security and compliance.

  • Onboarding, access rights, information sharing

  • Working with trustworthy contractors

  • Tooling: audit of all tool configurations, and keeping critical software (e.g., our GlobaLeaks instance) up to date

  • Incident policy and response

  • Security input and strategy on new technology and developments

  • Full review of the current setup, identifying vulnerabilities to inform wider strategy and next steps

  • IT helpdesking (supporting Operations to field the right ones your way)

2. External: insiders and coalition members.

  • Guidance, video content, and op-eds

  • Assisting coalition members

  • Device provisioning

  • Being “ready” to urgently support security needs

  • Further services/offerings

3. Security engineering (full-time track only).

  • You will build and run the technical security layer behind AIWI’s internal and external systems, working alongside the Principal Engineer (e.g. Harden and monitor our self-hosted, set up; Build security tooling, automation, and detections in-house; Review architecture and code, and secure CI/CD and the software supply chain; Run offensive testing (pen tests, red teaming) on our own systems and tools, including our GlobaLeaks instance; Lead technical incident response and forensics; Take security engineering work off the Principal Engineer so they can focus on product delivery)

Requirements

Core (both profiles)

  • Experience working with and securing journalists, sources, whistleblowers, or others in high-risk sensitive environments.

  • Proven track record of delivering security trainings to diverse audiences in a variety of environments.

  • Demonstrated experience in source protection (how have you helped journalists or non-profits safeguard sources?).

  • Deep knowledge of secure platforms (e.g., able to explain the security differences between Signal and SimpleX, or between Qubes and Tails).

  • Proficiency in operational security, threat modeling, and risk management.

  • Familiarity with IDS, ITM, and DLP suites, and how to safeguard whistleblowers against these systems.

  • Experience drafting, enacting, and enforcing internal security controls and policies.

  • Knowledge of document, audio, and video watermarking systems, and counter-forensics.

  • Genuine, demonstrable commitment to AI safety and whistleblower protection.

  • 5-15 years experience, dependent on the projects you have worked on.

Additional for the full-time profile

  • Hands-on experience as a security engineer or builder, with a track record of shipping security tooling and infrastructure.

  • Strong coding skills in one or more of Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++, plus shell. You write security tooling, automation, and detections yourself, without relying on AI tools.

  • Offensive security experience (penetration testing, red teaming, exploit understanding). You can think and operate like an attacker.

  • Infrastructure security: Linux hardening, network segmentation, cloud and self-hosted setups, IaC (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.).

  • Application security: secure code review, OWASP Top 10, supply-chain security, secrets management.

  • Detection and response: logging, SIEM/IDS, forensics, incident handling.

Benefits

Package for full-time

  • £120,000 base

  • Up to 9% on UEL pension contribution

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public bank holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development budget

  • A home office or equipment stipend for hybrid staff

  • Wellness budget

  • Paid for co-working space in London/SF

  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Why join?

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes.

  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1.

  • Chance to define your personal career development.

  • Coaching by an AIWI co-founder, now board member and serial entrepreneur/CTO as well as close collaboration with an extremely experienced Principal Engineer.

Who you’d be joining:

AIWI is an independent non-profit launched in late 2024. We are ~4 team members today and are scaling to ~15 within the year, spread across the Bay Area, DC, and London. Joining now, you will significantly shape what the future of AI insider support looks like. We are funded until 2029.

Examples of our work to date:

  • Policy: We pushed for and shaped the EU AI Office's channel, the world's first AI whistleblowing channel. In the US, we support the federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act and have provided expert research input on implementing SB 53's incident reporting mechanisms through a research coalition, which we helped set up. Read our work in Tech Policy Press, the Institute for Law & AI, and Transformer, and see our AI Whistleblowing Law Best Practice Guide.

  • Insider education & support: Our online campaigns have reached thousands of company employees. We produce guides (available upon request), online courses, and help establish connections to our great partner attorneys and support (e.g. on legal advice and defense funding).

  • Advocacy: Anthropic published its whistleblowing policy and OpenAI strengthened theirs following our Publish Your Policies Campaign.

  • Network: We closely collaborate with the world's leading whistleblowing and AI organizations.

Our ambition is to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure. Joining us means dedicating yourself to achieving that goal with us.

Hiring process:

  1. Application review

  2. 30 minute screener call with recruiter

  3. 1 hour test review & technical interview with Technical Adviser

  4. Final interview with CEO & Head of People

  5. Reference

Referral program:

We provide a reward of £4,000 for successful referrals upon completion of a 6-month employment period. Allocation will occur based on a successful applicant's attribution in the case of multiple referrers.

How to apply:

  • Apply by submitting your application via Join.com.

  • We will begin reviewing applications on a rolling basis from January.

Work authorization:

  • For London-based roles, we can sponsor UK visas.

  • For US roles, we require candidates to have a right to work.

Equal Opportunity:

AIWI is an equal opportunities employer, in line with the UK Equality Act 2010. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace free from discrimination.

raw.title: Financial Accountant (15 Month FTC)
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Trustly is leading the human centric payments revolution. We build the most convenient, intelligent and responsible way of paying for things online, from shopping and subscriptions to funding trading accounts and booking flights. We are a tech company with industry leading capabilities, connecting thousands of businesses with hundreds of millions of people across Europe and the Americas.

This role sits in the Financial Reporting and Accounting team, part of Group Internal Finance, which also includes Tax, Treasury, Payroll, Finance Operations and Finance Systems. The team is collaborative and focused on continuous improvement.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the accounting for a portfolio of entities, including our Portuguese and Maltese entities, which are growing quickly alongside our Lisbon office. The scope is broad. You will cover accounting, payroll and expenses end to end, supported by detailed process notes and a close, experienced team.

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change and embrace new challenges. We are looking for motivated people who thrive in a fast paced setting and enjoy collaborating across the organisation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the month end close for your entities, preparing journals, accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules

  • Complete balance sheet reconciliations, including bank, intercompany and payroll accounts

  • Handle payroll accounting, including payroll journals and reconciling payroll costs to the general ledger

  • Handle expense accounting, including employee expenses and corporate card reconciliations

  • Review operating cost postings and make sure costs are coded correctly

  • Prepare monthly commentary on Balance Sheet and P&L variances

  • Support the year end audit by preparing schedules and answering auditor queries

  • Work through the monthly task list and close checklist for each entity

  • Revamp our reconciliations and process notes into one clear, audit ready Confluence section that shows how processes differ by country

  • Keep process documentation up to date so that colleagues can pick up the work when needed

  • Keep pace with the Portuguese entity as headcount and new departments grow

  • Join finance projects and suggest process improvements, working with Reporting, Tax, Treasury and FinOps

     

Qualifications:

  • Degree in accounting, finance or economics, or studying towards a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA, CIMA, ACA)

  • 2 to 3 years of accounting experience in industry

  • Comfortable with a broad scope that goes beyond pure accounting

  • Strong attention to detail and good Excel skills

  • NetSuite experience strongly preferred, or experience with another major ERP

  • Ideally experience in a startup or scale up, with an appetite to improve how things are done

  • Fluent English

  • Nice to have: experience with Portuguese or Maltese entities, and an interest in fintech

 

OUR FANTASTIC BENEFITS

  • 25 days of holiday to support a healthy work life balance;

  • Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues;

  • Parental leave top up, additional support for new parents;

  • Daily breakfast and on site perks to make your workday smoother;

  • Wellbeing support, our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages and much more to help you feel your best;

  • PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work life experience!

SHAPE YOUR ROLE AND MAKE AN IMPACT

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change and continuously embrace new challenges. We're looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

raw.title: Partner Solutions Engineer
raw.description:
About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll work side by side with our Head of Partnerships to help partners build, integrate, and deploy computer vision solutions with Ultralytics YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, scope partner projects, and turn requirements into practical solution architectures, demos, and deployments.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role with no people-management responsibilities. You'll collaborate with partners and internal engineering teams across model training, export, quantization, and cross-platform deployment. You'll thrive here if you combine deep technical curiosity with clear communication, sound judgment, and a bias for getting working solutions into users' hands.

🚀 What you'll do
Partner solutions & delivery

  • Lead partner-facing technical calls, discovery, and project scoping.

  • Design solution architectures for YOLO training, integration, export, and deployment.

  • Build technical demos and rapid prototypes using Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Support model export and INT8 quantization across ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, and LiteRT.

  • Help partners deploy across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and document clear implementation guidance.


Technical collaboration

  • Work side by side with the Head of Partnerships to advance partner integrations and unblock technical work.

  • Review partner and community GitHub pull requests and share actionable feedback.

  • Use OpenAI and Anthropic APIs to prototype client tools and accelerate partner workflows.

  • Share partner needs and technical findings with Product and Engineering teams.


Partner enablement

  • Create technical documentation, demos, and integration guidance using the Ultralytics docs and guides.

  • Represent Ultralytics in partner meetings, technical events, and occasional travel.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Experience in computer vision and AI, with practical knowledge of Python, YOLO, OpenCV, and PyTorch.

  • Experience training, exporting, and deploying models; familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, QNN, LiteRT, and INT8 quantization.

  • Proven ability to lead partner-facing technical calls, scope work, and deliver demos or solution architectures.

  • Experience reviewing GitHub pull requests and writing clear technical documentation.

  • Comfortable working across Linux, macOS, and Windows, with Docker and common development workflows.

  • Strong spoken and written English; able to travel for partner meetings and events.

  • Resourceful, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a high-performance startup.


Nice to have

  • Deep knowledge of vendor SDKs such as CUDA, ROCm, Vela, or Vitis AI.

  • Experience with edge CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, including Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Snapdragon, or Arm platforms.

  • Linux, Docker, and CI experience on ARM64 and x86; mobile or web deployment on Android, iOS, or WebGPU.

  • C++ skills, performance profiling, or experience with PyTorch and OpenCV optimization.

  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms such as SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, and video pipelines like DeepStream or Triton.

  • Experience creating talks, blogs, or demo videos; additional Spanish, Italian, or Mandarin language skills.


🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine technical depth with a client-first, hands-on approach.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.


Our culture is built around our core values:

  • Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement.

  • Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail.

  • Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results.

  • Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities.

  • Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration.


Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive salary: Reflecting your experience and contribution.

  • Equity packages: We want our success to be yours too.

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs.

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI.


👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.

🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

  • This role is on-site at one of our global hubs: London or Madrid.

  • Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application.


We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.

🚀 Why join us
We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI. If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.

⚡ Ready to build the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI? Apply now.

What we offer:

Cutting-Edge, Next-Generation AI Computer Vision Technology: Contribute to building cutting-edge computer vision AI models based on the YOLO framework.

Impactful Work: Shape the future of AI-powered solutions that transform industries.

Collaborative Culture: Join a talented and passionate team that values open communication and innovation.

Ultralytics Handbook

Comprehensive guide to our company's mission, vision, values, and operational practices. This handbook is designed to provide key insights and resources for our (future) team members, collaborators, and community to align with Ultralytics' core principles.

Link: https://handbook.ultralytics.com/

Ultralytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

raw.title: Senior Account Executive - DACH
raw.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode! 

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at www.veracode.com, on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter. 

 

Our Senior Account Executives are key individuals who prospect, maintain, and expand relationships with accounts in assigned territories. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle including outbound prospecting, building pipeline, and closing business. We are looking for self-starters with a hunter mentality, exhibiting a consultative selling approach with our customers and channel partners.

What you'll be doing:

  • Learn the product offerings to become a subject matter expert for key clients.
  • Develop account and territory sales plans and strategies for assigned customer base in DACH region to meet assigned sales quotas and goals.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and maintain key relationships to educate current and potential clients on products and services.
  • Prepare and present sales proposals and quotations to clients.
  • Organize, track and maintain client account and contact information, as well as prospect updates in CRM database.
  • Review and negotiate complex agreements and be the primary contact for Veracode.
  • Own and resolve general sales inquiries pertaining to accounts and respond to RFPs.
  • Collaborate across the organization with business development, marketing, services, pre-sales engineering, renewals, development, and executive teams to ensure successful go to market strategies.
  • Attend and participate in trade shows and seminars as needed.
  • Participate in other tasks or projects as requested by supervisor/manager.

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum of 5 years of Sales experience selling SaaS in Cybersecurity industry
  • Fluent in German required
  • Proven track record of selling to technical audiences like Security, Dev/Ops and IT Operations, and C-Level suite
  • Strong business acumen and a proven history of quota over-achievement
  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly expanding and changing environment at a high growth company
  • Ability to work in both direct and channel selling environment
  • Clear understanding of procurement, negotiations and deal closing
  • Force Management experience desirable
  • SFDC or equivalent CRM experience
  • Travel required of up to 20%

What we offer you:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs
  • Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow with us
  • An annual contribution of 6% towards your pension
  • Life assurance, personal accident, and long-term disability insurance
  • Enhance parental leave initiatives as well as other family friendly benefits
  • Annual fitness reimbursements and access to apps that support wellbeing
  • Summer and end of year social events to bring the team together and celebrate our success

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here's our recruitment promise to you:

  • Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.
  • Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.
  • Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an ----- email address.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at

raw.title: Medical Product Owner
raw.description:
Vision RT is a fast-growing MedTech company transforming radiation therapy for cancer patients by helping make it more accurate, effective, and comfortable. The company is the inventor of, and a market leader in, Surface Guided Radiation Therapy (SGRT). This technology uses advanced 3D cameras to track surface data, providing enhanced guidance across every step of the radiotherapy workflow.
 
Our systems are used in over 3,000 clinics worldwide, including in 29 of the top 30 Best Hospitals for Cancer (source: US News and World Report 2026 rankings).
 
The company is recognized as one of Britain’s fastest-growing private tech companies, as featured in the 2025 Sunday Times 100 Tech list. Vision RT is also a recipient of the 2026 King’s Award for Enterprise, our fifth in 10 years. It is the UK’s most prestigious accolade for business excellence.
 
Company video (Available on application page)
 
With around 400+ employees globally and offices in the UK, Poland, and the USA, Vision RT operates independently as part of the Danish company William Demant Invest A/S, one of the world’s largest investors in healthcare companies. Employees benefit from the security and reach of being part of a large global enterprise, combined with the agility and innovation of a startup.
 
Vision RT is a company with strong values, a clear mission, and a bright future. It is an exciting and rewarding organization in which to work.
 

 
 
 
About the role:
 
As a Product Owner, you will support Product Management in creating the company Product Portfolio. This role involves collaborating with various stakeholders to align on delivery strategies, converting roadmap goals into actionable plans, and prioritizing the product backlog. You will have daily contact with engineering R&D teams, helping them understand customer needs and translate those into tangible solutions. Enhancing user experience and maintaining a structured backlog are essential. 
 
Travel Expectation: Approximately 10-25%, mainly EMEA

Key Responsibilities will include:
  • Collaborate closely with Key Stakeholders to align on the delivery strategy, goals, and objectives outlined in the Roadmap, considering both commercial and customer aspects.
  • Convert Roadmap objectives into a cohesive vision (e.g., through Product Goals and Sprint goals) for the R&D Teams, reflected in the Product Backlog prioritisation.
  • Emphasise the end-to-end user experience by utilising user journey mapping and working in partnership with Usability engineers and UX designers.
  • Provide and maintain a well-structured Product Backlog, clearly and transparently communicating requirements and deadlines. Optimise the scope of the projects to achieve business goals by delivering specific, measurable Key Results for the Teams.
  • Monitor Product Roadmap progress and communicate progress and status to Key Stakeholders.  Monitor Product performance to guide future initiatives.
  • Collect product feedback systematically and translate it into user needs in alignment with the Product Manager and PO Team. Collaborate closely with the PO Team.
  • Ensure the SGRT product is developed incrementally, releasing new functional features after each Sprint, to soliciting customer feedback and providing customer value.
  • Consistently engage with the Teams to provide feedback on ongoing work and clarify requirements during Scrum/LeSS events (dailies, refinements, planning, etc.). Ensure the Teams are aware of customer and commercial objectives.
  • Be available for clarification, providing guidance, challenging and answering when necessary to arrive at the best possible understanding of issues and proposed solutions.
  • Offer product training when needed.
  • Assist with SGRT community events and exhibitions when needed.
    •  

    Essential Skills & Experience
  • Background in the medical device industry, ideally with experience in Radiation Therapy; prior work as a Medical Physics is a strong advantage.
  • Strong interest in technology and innovation, with a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
  • Proven track record of leading or contributing to process enhancements and cross-functional projects, regardless of formal scope.
  • Self-driven and highly motivated, with a collaborative mindset.

raw.title: Mobile Penetration Tester
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Mobile Penetration Tester on a permanent basis for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.

The Role

As a Mobile Penetration Tester, you will lead hands-on offensive and defensive security testing across client mobile applications, supporting APIs, and underlying platforms. You are a technical specialist who identifies vulnerabilities before attackers do, ensuring quality, security, and compliance across high-profile projects.   

This role will be pivotal in uncovering flaws and driving the security of mobile ecosystems, working closely with our full-stack mobile engineering squads to embed offensive and defensive security insights across both front-end mobile clients and back-end systems.


Key aspects of the role include:

  • Mobile Penetration Testing & Assessments: Plan, scope, and execute comprehensive grey-box and black-box penetration tests across iOS and Android applications, APIs, and cloud-connected mobile architectures.

  • Vulnerability Analysis & Reverse Engineering: Perform deep-dive static and dynamic analysis, binary reverse engineering, and runtime manipulation to identify complex security flaws.

  • Actionable Reporting & Remediation: Produce clear, well-structured technical and executive reports detailing risk ratings, proof-of-concept exploits, and practical, code-level remediation advice for engineering teams.

  • Threat Modelling & Advisory: Partner with product squads and architects during design and delivery to conduct threat modelling, review security controls, and advise on secure mobile design.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate findings clearly to both technical teams and non-technical client stakeholders, managing expectations and guiding risk-based decision-making.

  • Security Research & Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of emerging mobile threats and bypass techniques, sharing knowledge and evolving our internal testing methodologies and tooling.


Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box!


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Hands-On Mobile Pentesting: Proven commercial experience conducting penetration tests and security assessments against iOS and Android applications (aligned with OWASP MASVS / MASTG) and associated REST/GraphQL APIs.

  • Mobile Platform Internals: Deep understanding of Android and iOS security architectures, sandboxing, IPC mechanisms, keystore/keychain storage, and common mobile vulnerability classes.

  • Dynamic & Static Analysis Tooling: Practical proficiency with mobile testing and reverse engineering tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, Apktool, Ghidra, IDA Pro, Hopper, ADB, and Xcode.

  • Bypass & Exploitation Techniques: Experience bypassing client-side controls including SSL/TLS pinning, root/jailbreak detection, anti-tampering, and obfuscation mechanisms.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong grasp of mobile authentication flows (OAuth2, OIDC, biometrics), session management, and cryptographic implementations, with the ability to spot flawed implementations.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Certifications: Recognised offensive and defensivesecurity or mobile-specific certifications such as CREST (CRT/CPSA), OSCP, OSWE, or GIAC GMOB.

  • Code & Scripting: Familiarity with reading/writing languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, Python, or Bash to review source code and automate testing tasks.

  • Low-Level & Cloud Security: Exposure to ARM/ARM64 assembly, native C/C++ libraries, or cloud environment assessments (AWS, Azure, GCP) supporting mobile backends.

  • DevSecOps Integration: Experience integrating automated security testing (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines within Agile delivery teams.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

raw.description:
WGSN | London | Permanent, full-time

About WGSN

For two decades, WGSN's proprietary trend intelligence has shaped how the world's most valuable brands in fashion, beauty, consumer goods, interiors and food and drink make decisions. Now those same brands are rebuilding their technology around AI (agents, knowledge platforms, recommendation engines and personalization systems) and they want WGSN forecast intelligence flowing into them as a data layer, delivered through the WGSN Intelligence API.

About the Role

You will be the solution lead on WGSN's largest and most complex new enterprise opportunities in EMEA. Partnering with Enterprise Account Directors, Product and Engineering, you will qualify, scope, design and close Intelligence API and data deals of $500k and above, mainly with new logos.

This is a hybrid technical and consultative role. You won't write code, and the API itself is simple. What matters is that you can sit credibly in two rooms: the commercial conversation with senior business leaders, and the technical conversation with the people who will integrate. Most of all, you'll make sure every deal grows WGSN's relationship with the client, protects the subscription business underneath it, and keeps our intelligence clearly credited to WGSN.

You'll report to the VP, working closely with our global commercial leadership, and you'll help raise the commercial standards of the wider North America sales team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the solution and commercial design on priority enterprise deals, turning pipeline into signed multi-year contracts.
  • Run discovery with senior buyers in design, insight, buying and merchandising, and with Chief Digital, Innovation and Data Officers.
  • Map where WGSN intelligence creates value in a client's data and AI plans, and be clear about what the API does and doesn't do.
  • Structure deals that open new use cases, new buyers and new budgets without cannibalizing the existing subscription.
  • Build IP protection and brand attribution into the solution, the commercial model and the licensing terms from day one.
  • Design and run paid pilots that give clients a credible first step.
  • Coach the sales team on qualification and deal design, build collateral and battle cards, and feed customer insight back to Product.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can tell true expansion from revenue moving between budget lines.
  • 6+ years in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting or solutions engineering, selling data, content, API or SaaS products to large enterprises.
  • A track record of leading the solution on $500k+ multi-year deals, including new logos.
  • Confidence with C-level and senior VP buyers, and the presence to lead a deal team.
  • Experience protecting IP, attribution and licensing in content, data or API deals, and the judgement to walk away when the terms are wrong.
  • Clear writing. You can produce a proposal an executive will sign and a solution outline an engineering lead will respect.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of fashion, beauty, retail, consumer goods or interiors, or of trend, research or consumer data businesses.
  • Experience with enterprise AI buying: agents, RAG, knowledge platforms, personalization engines.
  • MEDDPICC or a similar qualification method.
  • Spanish or Portuguese.

Experience

6 to 10 years in enterprise pre-sales or solutions consulting within SaaS, content, martech or data businesses.

 

What we offer

Our benefits and wellbeing package offers flexible benefits you can tailor to your own personal needs, including:  

- 25 days of holiday per year - with an option to buy/ sell up to 5 days
- Pension, Life Assurance and Income Protection Flexible benefits platform with options including Private Medical, Dental Insurance & Critical Illness 
- Employee assistance programme, season ticket loans and cycle to work scheme 
- Volunteering opportunities and charitable giving options  
- Great learning and development opportunities.


More about WGSN

WGSN is the global authority on consumer trend forecasting.

We help brands around the world create the right products at the right time for tomorrow’s consumer.


Our values 

We Are Everywhere
The future is everything, it happens everywhere. WGSN is the world-leading forecaster because we track and analyse consumer behaviours, product innovation, design and creativity, everywhere.

We Are Future Focused
We utilise our global resources and intelligence to research, source and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to produce our forecasts. Everything we do is focused on working with our customers to create a successful and positive tomorrow.

We Are Rigorous
We source, review and assess quantitative and qualitative data to produce robust, actionable forecasts. To provide credible insights and design solutions for our clients, it is essential that rigour runs through everything we do.


Our culture 

An inclusive culture is one of our key priorities. We want our people to truly be themselves and thrive. We love having a diverse team of people who bring new ideas, different strengths and perspectives & reflect the global audience we work with.


Inclusive workforce 

We are committed to supporting the environment and sustainability, including ensuring our pension plan defaults to sustainable options and striving to be net zero by 2030.  

Recognising great performance is a key part of our culture. Our Awards schemes recognise and reward the brilliant achievements of our people.  

We offer a flexible working environment with a wide range of flexible, hybrid and agile working arrangements. Conversations about flexible working have always been—and will continue to be—actively encouraged here, but we do not offer full remote working. 

We want to ensure everyone has the opportunity to perform their best when interviewing, so if you require any reasonable adjustments that would make you more comfortable during the process, please let us know so that we can do our best to support you.


A Note for Applicants

We use AI to help our team screen applications and identify candidates whose skills and experience match the role. This technology removes personal information to promote a fair and unbiased process. We believe this tool helps us find the best talent while maintaining transparency and fairness.


A Note for Recruiters 

Thank you so much for your interest in working with us at  WGSN!   Our internal Talent Acquisition team takes care of all our recruitment efforts. When we need some extra help, we partner with agencies on our Preferred Supplier List (PSL) that truly understand our business, culture and ways of working together.  Since we focus on these established partnerships, we’re unable to respond to unsolicited contacts or CVs from outside our PSL. But don’t worry! If we decide to explore new partnerships, we’ll be sure to reach out.

You are responsible for leading complex benchmark transformations and data deliverables. Rather than just managing timelines, you are architecting workflows to ensure the next generation of LLMs and multimodal models are trained on the most accurate, diverse, and complex data available, while championing innovative solutions alongside our research lab partners.

  • Entrepreneurial Benchmark Leadership: Act as the CEO of your customer’s business by proactively proposing and co-developing benchmark transcreations directly with research lab partners, ensuring our deliverables are innovative, tailored, and aligned with their core research objectives.

  • Frontier Lab Program Management: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-priority technical programs for frontier AI labs, managing the delivery of massive-scale datasets and bespoke engineering milestones.

  • High-Volume Data Operations: Architect and oversee pipelines for delivering high-volume data samples across multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio), ensuring strict adherence to delivery cadences without sacrificing precision.

  • End-to-End Quality Control: Partner with production to implement rigorous, automated, and human-in-the-loop QC frameworks to ensure data integrity across various domains and languages.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Bridge the gap between forward-deployed engineering resources, research, and production teams to ensure LILT can serve the needs of the frontier AI market.

Qualifications

  • Education: B.S or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 10+ years of industry experience. Equivalently, a Ph.D. with 5+ years of experience in a high-growth AI/Engineering environment.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience founding or scaling a venture, or operating in an early-stage startup environment where you drove business growth and strategic initiatives from the ground up.

  • Strategic Execution: Strong business acumen and the ability to manage high-stakes stakeholder relationships with frontier AI labs.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Proven track record of managing data pipelines for LLMs or multimodal models. Deep understanding of training, inference, and the nuances of data diversity (multilingual and multi-domain).

  • Scale & Quality: Demonstrated ability to manage "high-throughput" programs where quality control is mission-critical. You should have experience with automated validation at scale.

Preferred Skills

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks (PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Where You’ll Work

This position is based in our London, UK office and will be expected to work in the office in a hybrid capacity. Boston and Indianapolis are also acceptable locations. LILT is hybrid with hubs in SF, NY, Indianapolis, Boston, London, and Berlin.

 

Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

  • London, UK (highly preferred)

  • Others: Berlin, Boston, New York, Indianapolis

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

raw.description:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Senior Security Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to champion security initiatives across our cloud native, API-driven trading infrastructure. In this high impact capacity, you will take ownership of designing robust security controls, spearheading threat modeling exercises, and cultivating advanced security methodologies throughout the engineering organization. This hands-on role involves direct collaboration with Platform teams, DevOps, and Product Engineering to integrate security deeply into the Talos environment.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the SME across various security domains that include Appsec, DevSecOps, DFIR, CloudSec & Product Security

  • Manage and scale vulnerability lifecycle operations by triaging, prioritizing, and orchestrating remediation across the application and infrastructure landscape

  • Design, deploy, and maintain security tools and controls across complex application environments

  • Lead threat detection and incident response efforts, including investigation, containment, and post-incident analysis

  • Tune detections to align with business risk within the Talos environment

  • Evaluate and enforce security standards aligned with security frameworks

  • Partner with TechOps, DevOps, and business stakeholders to embed security into system and application design

  • Develop and maintain security documentation including runbooks, SOP’s, and architecture diagrams

  • Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends relevant to the financial & digital assets sector

  • Spearhead threat modeling exercises, comprehensive security reviews, and penetration testing initiatives for both emerging and legacy platform architecture

Requirements

 

  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering or a closely related discipline

  • Demonstrated experience securing financial services environments or other regulated industries

  • Proficiency with SIEM platforms & threat hunting

  • Hands-on experience with industry standard security tools

  • Solid understanding of network security principles, including segmentation, Zero Trust, and secure remote access

  • Experience with cloud security in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments as well as on prem infrastructure

  • Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

 

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

  • Bonus and stock ownership

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service

  • Global offsites and team outings

  • A one-time stipend towards at-home office set-up for all employees

  • A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes.

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Donation matching up to $100 USD annually

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

 

Check out other open positions listed on our website

raw.description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Major Enterprise Account Executive

You’d join a high-performing team of Account Executives and own a mixed book of spending accounts with real expansion potential alongside a host of untapped prospect accounts to hunt and win. Our Majors look after our biggest customers in the region.

You'll split your time between working alongside peers in the office and getting in front of customers and partners in the field. We have beautiful office space near Borough Market with a real sense of team spirit and shared goals. This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing the largest and most high value customers Amplitude has in the region.

  • Running full enterprise sales cycles with a value-first mindset — discovery, demos, and exec presentations tailored to what you heard, not templated

  • Building pipeline through outbound, AI-assisted tools, SDR partnership, marketing programmes, and the partner ecosystem

  • Applying MEDDPICC with real rigour — qualifying hard, building Champions, getting to Economic Buyers early, and forecasting with confidence

  • Becoming a product evangelist across Marketing, Product, and Engineering personas — selling technical and commercial value at every level

  • Working the full internal village: SDRs, Solutions Consultants, Partners, Customer Success, Legal — everyone aligned around customer value

  • Supporting the team with coaching and acting as a senior example.

What we're looking for

  • Enterprise SaaS or AI sales experience, ideally with deals in the $300 - $1m + ARR range

  • A genuine hunter — consistent pipeline generation and a land-and-expand mindset

  • MEDDPICC (or equivalent) applied in how you run deals, not just how you update your CRM

  • Strong C-suite presence — able to uncover business value beyond features and build relationships that last

  • Naturally curious and empathetic; someone who experiments with the sale process rather than just running the same play

  • Data or analytics background is a plus, but not a dealbreaker

  • Experience selling to a business stakeholder, ideally marketing, product or data.

 
 

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The AppSec team sits inside Cyber Security and owns secure development across a large, GitHub-based engineering organisation shipping payments software in AWS and Kubernetes.

What the role owns:

- Threat modelling (STRIDE) embedded in the Architecture Review Board, so engineering designs keep moving

- Application vulnerability management: triage, prioritisation, SLA tracking and escalation across code, dependencies, IaC and APIs, with AppSec accountable for closure

- Remediation tracking for penetration test and bug bounty findings

- Security reviews of AI tooling and MCP integrations before they are approved for use: tool permissions, data egress, prompt injection and credential handling

- Ownership of the tooling: SonarCloud, GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning), 42Crunch for API specs, Claude Security for AI-driven vulnerability discovery and fixes, and the internally built PR security gates

Who we are looking for:

A hands-on AppSec lead who has run a small function before and can hold their own with senior engineers.

Must have:

- 7+ years in security, at least 4 in application or product security, including leading or running an AppSec function (team of 2 to 4)

- Threat modelling of cloud-native services, done personally and at pace, not just facilitated - Reads code well enough to judge a finding in at least two of .NET, Go, Python and TypeScript

- Hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, Dependabot) and SonarCloud or SonarQube, including tuning and false-positive management

- Vulnerability management at scale: SLAs, prioritisation, escalation, and the engineering relationships that make remediation happen

- AWS and Kubernetes security fundamentals; API security - Can run security reviews of AI tooling, agents and MCP integrations, covering tool permissions, data egress, prompt injection and credential handling

- Experience in a PCI DSS or otherwise regulated environment; payments or fintech preferred

Nice to have:

- AI-assisted code review with Claude Security or similar, and securing AI-generated code and AI-powered services

- 42Crunch; Azure alongside AWS

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

We’re expanding Finance Business Partnering to support new business units. In this role, you’ll own the finance partnership for an assigned business unit and work directly with its leadership.

This is not a budget-reporting role. You’ll help shape how your business grows, connecting revenue strategy, go-to-market choices, investment and cost management in one clear financial model. You’ll turn commercial and operating plans into practical forecasts, challenge assumptions with evidence, and give leaders the insight to make better decisions. You’ll work with significant autonomy in a changing environment, building the financial partnership and planning discipline each business unit needs to scale.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the lead Finance partner to your assigned business unit leader, building a trusted relationship and bringing a clear, independent financial perspective to strategic and operating decisions.

  • Own the unit’s integrated financial model and performance narrative, linking revenue drivers, costs, investment, headcount and profitability.

  • Partner on end-to-end revenue strategy and go-to-market planning. Translate commercial choices into targets, forecasts and scenarios, and assess the financial implications of different growth paths.

  • Lead annual planning, forecasting and budget reviews for your unit. Recut plans as the operating model develops, making assumptions, trade-offs and risks explicit.

  • Track performance against plan, explain the drivers behind results, identify emerging opportunities or gaps, and recommend actions rather than simply reporting variances.

  • Build a strong view of unit economics and the metrics that matter, identifying the measures that best reflect the unit’s growth, customer economics and investment model.

  • Evaluate investment and resource choices, including hiring, dedicated product and technology capacity, and other material operating costs. Help ensure costs and resources are transparently attributed to the business unit they support.

  • Work across Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations and central Finance to align plans, validate assumptions and resolve trade-offs.

  • Create concise, decision-ready analysis and performance updates for business-unit and Finance leadership, translating complex financial information into clear choices.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in FP&A, strategic finance, commercial finance or a comparable business-partnering role.

  • You pair strong financial modelling skills with practical AI fluency, using AI tools to build and improve models and analytical workflows, and applying sound financial judgement to validate the outputs.

  • A track record of owning planning and forecasting and using financial models to influence commercial or operating decisions.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to connect revenue drivers, costs, investment and profitability.

  • Confidence partnering directly with senior leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • The ability to make complex financial information clear and actionable for non-finance audiences.

  • Comfort working with autonomy in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment, while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

  • Experience in fintech or another high-growth business is an advantage.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Company & Function Overview

Checkout.com is seeking a dedicated individual to join the Treasury New Products function within Group Treasury. This team sits at the critical intersection of product development, commercial strategy, and treasury risk management & execution. Acting as a strategic conduit between product/engineering teams and treasury subject matter experts (SMEs) across multiple disciplines, this team ensures new product initiatives globally—from greenfield launches to complex payment flows—are financially sound, scalable, and compliant.

As Checkout.com expands its ecosystem, this role will serve as the primary driver and subject-matter expert for digital assets related initiatives from a Treasury perspective. Over time, the role holder will also build a deep, end-to-end understanding of Checkout’s broader infrastructure and product stack, enabling holistic, cross-domain strategic thinking and long-term portfolio diversification.

Position Overview

In this role, you will be the gateway between Product and Treasury, translating innovative product ideas into methodologies, pragmatic design of processes and putting them into practices.

Global Crypto & Blockchain Initiative Leadership across two dimensions: You will act as the dedicated Treasury partner to enable Product-led crypto and digital asset initiatives, while also directly leading Treasury-driven digital asset native projects driving transformation and optimisation.

Holistic Checkout Infrastructure and Multi Product Mastery: While taking primary ownership of the digital asset roadmap, you will actively expand your expertise across Checkout’s core non-crypto infrastructure and product stack to ensure seamless integration with the fiat payments ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnering & Discovery: Work with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product, Engineering, Commercial and Legal) to review and advise on crypto/ digital asset related product development opportunities from the Treasury standpoint, helping to shape the strategy and path for execution.

  • Single Point of Contact: Act as a primary point of contact for the Product teams, ensuring effective communication and coordination with relevant Treasury (SMEs). And vice versa.

  • Business Requirement Ownership: Assess impacts for Treasury, and synthesize requirements from Treasury SMEs across different disciplines and geographies—including those related to risk management, bank relations, data, system integration and operational processes—are translated into actionable, prioritised business requirements incorporated into new product development and optimisation efforts.

  • Digital Asset Native Treasury Leadership: Drive the digital assets native strategy and lead implementation to modernise the approach, infrastructure and tooling for Checkout’s Treasury management, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Operational Readiness: Ensure that capabilities, data flows, and risk controls are robustly built, and processes and procedures are stood up before products go live and scale in production.

  • Cross-domain excellence: Proactively develop all-round knowledge of Checkout’s infrastructure, product stack and flow of funds. Leverage this cross-domain insight to solve complex overlapping challenges between fiat and digital asset products, and contribute to broader New Products deliveries.

  • New Products governance: Support the documentation and implementation of operating models, frameworks and policies relevant to New Products, and alignment at the Enterprise level


Required Skills & Experience

  • Domain Expertise: Practical, hands-on experience operating with crypto wallets, or within the digital assets ecosystems (e.g., at a crypto-native firm, fintech innovator, or digital-asset banking unit).

  • Treasury or Product Management Background: Hands-on experience in Treasury/Finance change management OR Product Management with direct exposure to complex payment infrastructure, flow of funds, and cash management.

  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and engage effectively with different stakeholders.

  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and analytical skills with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

  • Communications: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly.

  • Details & Velocity: Excellent attention to detail and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in new product assessments, project management, or business advisory roles.

  • An understanding of complex payment and flow of funds.

  • Familiarity with financial resource management or cash management practices.

Checkout.com believes nothing matters more than its people. HumanOS is how we act on that:
