calibration for the whole company. Hive holds every major initiative, its owners and its

dependencies. We are building agents on top of both to take over the work people do by hand:

drafting goals, sizing impact, and chasing status.

We are a small team of engineers sitting in the CEO Office. Our users are every employee,

every manager and the executive team. Our job is to make sure that when the company grows,

the process overhead does not.

What you’ll do

  • Work with product to understand the problem behind every request. Sit with users and

dig into the data before writing code.

  • Challenge the approach when it won’t solve the problem. Propose simpler fixes, flag

what users will not adopt, and push back with evidence.

  • Ship end to end in Fabric and Hive, from data model to UI, used by every employee at

Checkout

  • Build AI agents that replace manual work in performance and planning, then measure

whether they solved the problem

  • Turn processes designed by our Strategy & Operations team into software that runs

without them

  • Connect our tools to where work happens: Workday, Jira, Slack, Google Workspace,

Looker and BigQuery

  • Own the outcome in production, not just the release

What we’re looking for

  • A track record of solving problems, not just shipping code. You can point to work where

you changed the approach because the original plan would not have worked.

  • You take a loosely defined problem and get to a working first version in days

  • You care whether a feature gets used and solves the problem, not whether it got merged

  • Strong full-stack engineer with production TypeScript, React and Next.js experience

  • You have built with LLMs beyond a demo: prompts, tools, evals, and knowing when not

to use one

  • Good judgment with sensitive data. Performance and people data needs care.

  • You work AI-first and use coding agents daily

Nice to have

  • Prisma, Postgres, Bun, AWS

  • Data work in BigQuery or Looker

  • Experience building internal tools or HR, people or planning products

  • Impact you can see. Your users sit down the hall. You ship on Monday and hear about

it on Tuesday.

  • Altitude. You build the system the executive team uses to run the company, and see

how it runs end to end.

  • Real AI work. Agents are core to the product, not a side project.

  • Ownership. Small team, big surface area. You own whole features end to end, not

tickets.

raw.title: Sales Enablement Lead
raw.description:
You make every rep and every manager on our commercial team better, every week, so we win more of the deals that matter.

WHAT WE ARE BUILDING AT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to hear from real people at scale and turn what they say into decisions.

#1 WHAT PROBLEM ARE WE SOLVING

In a year our commercial team has grown to 60+ client-facing people across New York, San Francisco, London and Antwerp, and we’re doubling again. Hiring great people is only half the job. The other half is making every one of them great, fast, and keeping them there. That’s this role.

#2 THE TEAM YOU WILL JOIN

You’ll report to our VP Sales and work hand in hand with Talent Development, who are building our enablement system: the knowledge hub, the competency framework and the skills data behind it. You make that system real on the ground: on calls, in deals and in 1:1s. You’ll work every day with our Sales Directors, Client Growth Managers, Research Impact Leads and the managers who lead them, and closely with Sales leadership, Product Marketing and GTM Ops.

#3 HOW WE OPERATE

  • Relentless ownership. See it. Own it. Don’t wait to be asked.

  • Low ego, radical candor. Say the hard thing because you care.

  • Think AI first. Start from the agent, not the spreadsheet.

  • Speed. We execute with the smallest possible team. We work hard and we have fun.

THE ROLE

As Sales Enablement Lead, you own how our reps and managers get better. You coach in the field, turn our skills and pipeline data into action, and hold reps and managers to the development plans they commit to.

This is not a role for building slide decks or running a learning platform. It’s for someone who has carried a number, knows exactly what good sounds like on a call, and wants to get a whole team performing at that level.

YOUR MISSION

1. Coach the field

  • Run weekly call reviews, deal clinics and live sessions across Sales, Client Growth and Research Impact.

  • Lift the skills that win complex deals: deep discovery, building the business case, multi-threading and closing with a clear next step.

  • Bring top performers into the room so what works spreads across the team, and design and run the enablement at our team off-sites.

Your bar: reps feel the difference on their next call, not next quarter.

2. Coach the coaches

  • Work with every sales manager on how they coach, not just on what their team does.

  • Prepare managers for 1:1s with each rep’s skills data, and agree development plans together.

Your bar: managers run sharper 1:1s because you’ve been in them.

3. Turn data into action

  • Read call-skills scores alongside pipeline, win rates and stage velocity, and spot the patterns by role, region and stage.

  • Decide where coaching goes next, then prove whether it moved the numbers.

  • Use AI agents and practice avatars to scale coaching beyond the hours in your day.

Your bar: every coaching decision has a number behind it.

4. Ramp people and hold the line

  • Run onboarding for each new cohort of Sales Directors and certify them before they go live.

  • Follow through on every development plan with reps and managers, and report progress to leadership every week.

Your bar: new reps ramp faster, and no development plan goes quiet.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • In 90 days: you know every rep, every manager and every deal that matters. A weekly coaching rhythm is live in every region, and every manager has a development plan for each person on their team.

  • In 6 months: the difference is measurable. Deeper discovery, sharper business cases, and deals that keep moving instead of stalling.

  • In 12 months: we have a world-class commercial team. New reps ramp in record time, every manager coaches with data, and the best sellers want to join Conveo because of how we develop people.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must-haves

  • You’ve done the job. A consistent record of hitting quota as an AE or Sales Director in B2B SaaS, selling complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • You’ve made others better. As a team lead, player-coach or enablement lead, with results you can point to.

  • You coach managers as well as reps, and senior sellers take your feedback seriously.

  • You’re fluent with data. At home in HubSpot (or Salesforce), call-recording tools and dashboards, and you turn numbers into a coaching plan.

  • You hold people accountable, warmly and directly.

Mindset

  • A go-getter. You go and find the problem instead of waiting for it to land on your desk.

  • Energised by speed, ambiguity and a company that’s doubling in size.

  • AI-first. You already use AI to work faster, and you want to build with it.

Bonus

  • Tech sales experience; even better, market research, insights or consulting.

  • You’ve built or run onboarding in a hyper-growth scale-up.

  • Experience coaching teams across the US and Europe.

WHY JOIN US

  • Shape how a fast-growing AI company sells, from the ground up.

  • Work directly with our founders and sales leadership.

  • Join the cutting edge of how a business works: AI-first in everything we do, from how we sell to how we grow our people.

PLUS

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.

  • Hybrid working, with offices in New York, San Francisco, London and Antwerp.

  • A culture built on taste, speed, ownership, and ambition.

Compensation: £75K – £80K • Offers Equity

  • • £75K – £80K • Offers Equity

raw.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

As part of a lean, highly collaborative IT team, you'll support a fast-scaling global workforce and help drive automation, security, and operational excellence across the business. We're looking for an IT Engineer to be the hands-on IT presence for our London office and the first point of contact for IT across EMEA.

You'll be the only IT team member in London, five hours ahead of our IT teammate in New York and eight hours ahead of San Francisco. You'll resolve tickets and day-to-day issues yourself, and scope and align on larger projects with the team before building. Expect occasional calls outside UK hours.

Automation is the core of the job. You'll co-own identity and access management, endpoint administration, and SaaS operations for the company, using Serval, our AI-native service management platform, to turn recurring requests into workflows that resolve themselves. If a request shows up twice, the second time should be the last time anyone handles it by hand.

In this role, you will

  • Serve as the on-site IT engineer for our London office and the go-to IT contact for employees across EMEA, resolving hardware, account, and access issues in person and through the ticket queue

  • Build, test, and maintain Serval workflows for access requests, onboarding and offboarding, password and MFA resets, and other recurring requests

  • Review the automations Serval suggests from ticket history, and decide what gets published and what approvals each one needs

  • Track which requests still need a human, and use ticket data to choose what to automate next

  • Co-own the employee identity lifecycle through Okta so that onboarding, offboarding, and access changes are accurate and on time, with time-bound access and approval rules that make least privilege the default

  • Configure and maintain SSO, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM integrations as we bring on new SaaS applications

  • Administer and evolve our core SaaS stack, including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and similar tools

  • Co-own Mac endpoint management through Rippling MDM, including configuration policies, OS and app patching, compliance enforcement, and device logistics for EMEA employees

  • Write Python and Bash automation for integrations and API work that falls outside Serval

  • Act as first responder for IT and access incidents during EMEA hours, judging when to resolve an issue yourself and when to escalate to the US team

  • Support security and compliance work, including MFA enforcement, audit-ready evidence for SOC 2, and data protection requirements for EMEA employees

  • Keep runbooks and the Serval knowledge base current so employees can find answers themselves and the US team can pick up your work at handoff

Your background looks something like this

  • 5–7 years of experience in IT systems, endpoint, or identity engineering, ideally at a fast-growing company

  • Hands-on administration experience with Okta

  • Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

  • Experience managing SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Rippling, and Claude

  • Experience with Mac endpoint management (Rippling or similar MDM)

  • Automation you've shipped and can measure, whether scripts in Python or Bash or workflows in an iPaaS or ITSM platform, with results you can point to, such as ticket volume you eliminated

  • Experience as the sole or senior IT person at a site, comfortable making day-to-day decisions and knowing when a change needs sign-off

  • Strong async written communication, including clear handoffs, decision notes, and documentation as thorough as what you build

  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across systems that touch identity, networking, and SaaS integrations

  • Willingness to work in our London office 5 days a week

Even better if you have

  • Experience with Serval or another AI-native ITSM platform

  • Experience with iPaaS platforms like Workato, Zapier, or Tines

  • Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure administration

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or UK GDPR

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)

  • Okta certifications

  • Experience supporting EMEA employees at a US-headquartered company

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

Decagon offers a competitive benefits package that varies by country and complements local statutory benefits. Details for this location will be provided during the recruitment process.

Compensation: £50K – £75K • Offers Equity

  • • Base Salary £50K – £75K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Senior Global Manager, Enterprise Ads & Promos
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Global Advertising Manager

​​Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Advertising team sits at the intersection of commerce, data and marketing helping restaurant and grocery partners accelerate growth through smart, insight-led media solutions. From shaping high-impact campaign strategies to optimising performance at scale, we combine commercial acumen with deep marketplace insight to unlock value for our partners while driving sustainable revenue growth for Deliveroo.

We're looking for a Senior Global Advertising Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us craft and execute advertising strategies that exceed the needs of our restaurant partners and drive quarterly growth, both directly with key partners and at scale through enabling and leading global commercial teams.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Ads and Account Management team. We focus on building deep partnerships, enabling commercial teams, and crafting tailored media strategies to accelerate partner growth across our marketplace.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Identify Data-Led Opportunities: Proactively identify scope to increase advertising penetration and spend using a combination of data analytics and commercial insight.

  • Develop Processes & Go-To-Market Programs: Originating programs and reporting frameworks that organise commercial teams behind key opportunities to track progress effectively.

  • Enable Teams & Build Playbooks: Build playbooks, training, and go-to-market materials that equip global commercial and account management teams to maximise advertising revenue.

  • People & Team Leadership: Manage, coach, and support team members, setting clear goals and fostering a culture of high performance and professional growth.

  • Partner Strategy & Campaign Management: Work directly with major restaurant partners to understand marketing objectives, propose tailored ad solutions, and coordinate campaign launches, management, and reporting.

  • Performance Monitoring & Optimisation: Proactively monitor campaign performance, identifying, communicating, and resolving any issues to exceed partner objectives.

  • Shape Product Solutions: Act as the voice of our partners to feed structured feedback back into internal teams, informing how we iterate and build improved advertising and reporting products.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Commercial Advertising Experience: Significant experience in commercially focused roles, with a strong background in performance advertising or account management.

  • People Leadership & Management: Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop team members, driving high engagement and performance against commercial targets.

  • Strategy & Process Scaling: Demonstrated capability in defining, launching, and scaling go-to-market strategies and operational processes across teams.

  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional relationship-building skills with a proven ability to work effectively and build trusted relationships with multiple internal and external partners.

  • Analytical & Innovative Thinking: Highly analytical mindset with strong capability to interpret data and turn findings into strategic commercial recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Digital Marketing & Marketplace Experience: Prior exposure to digital marketing environments, e-commerce, or aggregator platforms.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. 

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 

 

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Global Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our London office as part of a Global DoorDash Engineering team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office).

Our New Verticals team exists to grow monthly active usage outside of restaurant ordering — groceries, retail, and everything in between. That means turning someone who only orders restaurant food into someone who also uses the app for a grocery run, and turning dormant users into active ones. You'll work on the surfaces that make that happen: the homepage, vertical landing pages, and the notifications that bring people back. This role sits closer to the personalisation and ranking side of that mission, working alongside colleagues across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve ranking models for vertical landing pages (grocery, retail), deciding what a user sees first when they land on a store page
  • Design models that blend new-vertical content into a homepage built around restaurant ordering, without disrupting the core experience
  • Build personalisation models that translate a user's existing behaviour into relevant recommendations for verticals they haven't tried yet
  • Contribute to notification targeting — who gets notified, with what message, and when, to drive adoption of new verticals

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist, with a proven ability to write high-quality production code in Python
  • Experience with end-to-end model productionisation
  • A bias to simplicity, where you care most about achieving impact
  • Background in personalisation, ranking, or recommender systems; exposure to causal inference or uplift modelling is a genuine plus but not expected

raw.title: Senior Payroll Analyst
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Analyst to join our Global Payroll team and play a key role in the delivery and continuous improvement of payroll across our international markets.

This is a senior operational role with responsibility for overseeing payroll activity across multiple countries. You will bring strong payroll expertise, sound judgement and a proactive approach to ensure employees are paid accurately, on time and in compliance with local legislation.

Working closely with the Payroll Team, internal HR and People teams, Finance, Tax and external payroll providers, you will take ownership of complex payroll activities, provide subject-matter expertise and act as a key escalation point for payroll issues.

The role will also provide opportunities to support international payroll projects, process improvements, system implementations and automation, helping Deliveroo build a scalable and efficient global payroll operation.

What you'll be doing

  • Take ownership of the end-to-end payroll delivery for assigned international entities.
  • Partner with local HR, People Operations, Finance and Tax teams to ensure payroll inputs are complete, accurate and delivered within agreed timelines.
  • Review, validate and approve payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, trends and potential risks before payroll is finalised.
  • Apply a strong understanding of legislation across multiple jurisdictions, statutory requirements and payroll practices, ensuring processes remain compliant and appropriately controlled.
  • Work closely with external payroll providers, holding them accountable for accuracy, timeliness, compliance and service delivery.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex employee and stakeholder payroll queries, providing clear guidance and appropriate resolutions.
  • Perform and oversee payroll reconciliations, payment validation and statutory submissions, ensuring appropriate controls are completed and documented.
  • Analyse payroll data and reporting to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain strong payroll governance and documentation, ensuring processes, controls and procedures are consistently followed.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate payroll processes, reducing manual intervention and operational risk.
  • Support and lead payroll-related projects, including system implementations, payroll migrations, integrations, process changes and new entity onboarding.
  • Partner with Technology and payroll vendors to troubleshoot system and integration issues and support effective resolution.
  • Contribute to the development of payroll policies, procedures, controls and best practices across international markets.
  • Share knowledge and provide guidance to Payroll Analysts and other team members, helping to build capability and consistency across the wider team.
  • Stay up to date with changes to payroll legislation and communicate relevant impacts to internal stakeholders and payroll providers.
  • Support the Payroll Lead with wider global payroll initiatives and deputise where required.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience working in a payroll analyst or senior payroll position, ideally within a complex, international organisation.
  • Strong hands-on experience of international payroll, with experience of Italy and/or France payroll highly desirable.
  • Good working knowledge of Italian and/or French payroll legislation, statutory requirements and payroll processes is preferable.
  • Experience managing payroll across multiple countries and working with third-party payroll providers.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations, payments, statutory reporting and compliance.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate payroll data, identify discrepancies and understand the root cause of issues.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on payroll accuracy and risk management.
  • Experience of identifying and implementing process improvements, automation and operational efficiencies.
  • Experience supporting or leading payroll projects, system implementations or payroll migrations.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with payroll data and reporting.
  • Experience with Workday/Cloudpay or other HR/payroll technology is preferred.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge, influence and provide a clear point of view.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex payroll matters clearly to both payroll and non-payroll stakeholders.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to question the why and the how behind existing processes.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - EMEA Pricing and Affordability
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack - EMEA Pricing and Affordability

You'll join EMEA Pricing & Affordability, the team that owns how an order is priced for consumers across EMEA: service and delivery fees, distance-based pricing and surcharges, fee discounts and the benefits that subscribers get. Our work sits right at the cart and checkout, on the new Pedregal platform shared across Deliveroo and Wolt.

Price is the most visible part of every order. Getting it right means customers can see what they'll pay and trust it, and can afford to order again. That drives conversion, order frequency and retention, and it is one of the biggest levers on both consumer growth and marketplace economics. Our roadmap covers subscriber pricing, service fee optimisation, distance-based pricing, long distance surcharges and priority delivery, so the work reaches millions of orders in many markets.

As a full stack engineer on this team you'll take pricing features from idea to production: designing fee and discount logic on the backend, building the checkout and basket experience that shows it, and measuring the result through experiments. You'll be expected to be comfortable with Go and React, with correctness and testing for money-critical code, and with working closely with Product, Data and the teams across Pedregal. raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

 

About the Team

Deliveroo's GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

 

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You'll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems and pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead the design of infrastructure that helps teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

  • Own and evolve our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

  • Architect scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

  • Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

  • Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with — and raise the technical bar for — ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

  • Set technical direction for the future of the company's centralised GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimisation, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalisation.

 

We're excited about you because…

  • BSc, MSc or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering

  • Deep backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems.

  • Track record of designing and owning production services, APIs, data pipelines, or ML infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience operating systems in production, including observability, debugging, reliability, incident response, and performance/cost optimization.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM inference and/or fine-tuning of open-weight models in production — serving (latency, throughput, batching, autoscaling, GPU utilization) and/or fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA).

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: leading design across ambiguous, fast-moving technical areas, mentoring engineers, and turning customer use cases into reusable platform capabilities

  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

 

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with LLM inference engines and serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) in production

  • Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

  • GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimisation, quantisation (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

  • Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

  • Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

  • Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

  • Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

  • Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

raw.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
raw.description:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Customer Success at Duffel

Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Project Implementation Manager to own every new customer's journey from signed contract to a live, transacting integration. This is a new, senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success, with a direct line of sight to the leadership team.

You'll run each onboarding as a project with a plan, a date and named owners, working with our Solutions Engineer so customers go live on time and with the right setup for their proposition. You'll also hold the view across every onboarding in flight, give the leadership team a clear, regular read on progress and risk, and work with internal teams to remove friction, automate manual steps and shorten the time it takes customers to go live.

Our customers include some of the largest fintech and software platforms in the world, building flights, stays and more on top of Duffel's API. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Own each onboarding end to end: take the handover from Sales at contract signature, run a structured kick-off, and lead the customer through to go-live and their first live bookings.

  • Build and run a project plan for every onboarding, covering commercial setup, API integration milestones, payments and finance setup, testing and launch, and be the customer's single point of contact for status.

  • Pull in the right people across Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Engineering, Payments, Finance and Travel Operations, spot blockers early, and escalate when a date slips.

  • Keep one source of truth for every onboarding in flight, prioritise across them, and report weekly to the VP, Customer Success and monthly to the leadership team.

  • Build a repeatable onboarding playbook, track time-to-live, on-time go-live rate and time to first transaction, and feed recurring friction back to Product and Engineering.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years running customer onboarding, implementation or technical project delivery in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments or another API-first business, with a track record of getting several complex onboardings live on time at once.

  • Enough technical fluency to follow API-led integrations (REST APIs, webhooks, sandbox vs production, test plans) and hold your own with engineers. You don't need to write code.

  • Confidence with senior customer stakeholders, and calm, direct escalation: you raise a slipping date early, with a proposed fix and a named owner.

  • Experience building process where little exists, such as a playbook, tracker or reporting cadence, and getting other teams to adopt it, plus clear written status reports a leadership team can read in two minutes.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in travel tech, onboarding enterprise platforms that embed a third-party API, or being the first person in a new function is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: getting to know every onboarding in flight, who's involved and where each one is stuck, with a single tracker in place and a first status report to leadership.

  • By 90 days: every new customer gets a kick-off, a project plan and a committed go-live date, a v1 onboarding playbook is in use, and baseline time-to-live is measured.

  • Designing the onboarding model by segment, from white-glove onboarding for large platforms to a lighter, scalable path for smaller accounts.

  • In your first year: time-to-live measurably shorter, most onboardings going live on the date agreed at kick-off, and a playbook solid enough to hand to the next hire into the team.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

Perks That Actually Matter:

✈️ Travel Allowance: We literally pay you to get out of town and explore the world.

🏝️ Work From Anywhere: Flexibility is built in. Work remotely, or take advantage of our Sabbatical Policy.

⚡ Electric Car Scheme: Roll up in a brand-new EV with eco-friendly tax savings.

⚖️ Work-Life Harmony: Flexible bank holidays, generous family leave, and a dedicated volunteering day.

📚 Growth Tools: Paid study days to level up your skills, plus a solid pension and cycle-to-work scheme.

🏥 Health & Wellbeing: Private healthcare, eye test cover, and season ticket loans.

🏡 Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption)

The Details

📍 Location: Shoreditch, London (Hybrid: In-office Tuesdays & Thursdays).

🧠 Interview Process: Simple & transparent:

  1. Talent Team Chat

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Stage Interview

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

Note to recruitment agencies Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.

raw.description:
We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel.

Customer Success at Duffel

Customer Success owns Duffel's relationship with our customers once the contract is signed. We help them integrate, launch and grow on Duffel across Flights, Stays and more. The team brings together Customer Success Managers, Customer Success Engineers and Technical Support Engineers across London and New York, led by our VP, Customer Success. We're growing the team and building the processes that help customers go live faster and get more from Duffel.

The Role

We're hiring a Solutions Engineer: the technical expert who helps customers design the right Duffel solution during the sales process, then guides them through building it until they go live.

In pre-sales, you'll join our Account Executives on discovery calls and pitches, bringing the technical depth to understand how a customer's product works and design how Duffel fits into it. Once the deal is signed, you'll take that design into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact, making sure they go live smoothly with the best setup for their use case.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP, Customer Success. You'll be our first Solutions Engineer, so the way you do this job will become how the team works as it grows. That could lead to managing a team of solutions engineers, or to a principal-level technical role shaping how our largest customers build on Duffel. Most of our transaction volume is in the US, so you'll work closely with US-based customer teams from London.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Join Account Executives on discovery calls, pitches and technical deep-dives, running technical discovery on the customer's product, architecture, user journeys and travel use case.

  • Design the solution, build demos and proofs of concept, and write solution designs and implementation scopes so customers know what they're building before they sign. Answer technical questions in RFPs and security reviews.

  • Take what you designed into implementation as the customer's technical point of contact: answer their engineers' questions, review integrations, define test plans and run go-live readiness checks.

  • Debug integration issues hands-on with Postman or curl and our API logs, working alongside the Senior Implementation Project Manager, who owns the project plan and dates.

  • Feed integration friction back to Product and Engineering, build reusable assets such as solution templates, sample code and demo apps, and define how pre-sales and implementation run at Duffel.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineer, sales engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager, at an API-first company.

  • Experience on both sides of the contract: supporting sales with discovery, demos and solution design, then implementing what was sold and taking enterprise customers live on complex integrations.

  • Hands-on API skills (REST, JSON, webhooks, authentication, sandbox vs production) and enough coding in a language such as JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby or Java to build a demo and spot what's wrong in a customer's integration.

  • The ability to explain a solution clearly to engineers and commercial decision-makers in the same meeting, and sound judgement on when to push back on a custom request or bring in Product.

  • Willingness to work regular US-overlap hours. Experience in payments, fintech or travel tech, writing statements of work, SQL or AI-assisted development tools is a bonus.

What you'll be working on

  • In your first 30 days: demoing Duffel's core flows end to end, building a test integration yourself, joining live sales calls and taking technical ownership of implementations already in flight.

  • By 90 days: leading technical discovery on new opportunities, with a written solution design before signature on every deal you work on.

  • Shaping how new Duffel products, such as Trains and our AI travel agent, are scoped and implemented for customers.

  • In your first year: customers designed in pre-sales going live faster with fewer surprises, a library of reusable solution templates and demo assets, and an evidence-based view of how the function should scale.

raw.title: AI Enablement Engineer
raw.description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.

Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in real time. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own outcomes. We’re a small but mighty crew where every person plays a critical role and we’re committed to using AI to work smarter and faster.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to join the Platform team in Product Delivery. You'll own the AI tooling our engineers use every day to design, build, review and ship software.

Our engineers share a common AI coding setup, including skills, plugins, MCP tools and conventions, so an improvement one person makes reaches everyone. You'll run that setup and keep making it better. That means building agents that take on parts of how we deliver, such as code review, and turning the corrections engineers make again and again into skills, hooks and automated checks.

What You'll Do

  • Own the shared AI coding setup and internal plugin marketplace, including skills, hooks, MCP tools, settings and safe access

  • Own our AI-driven development lifecycle and build agents for tasks such as code review

  • Use telemetry and engineer feedback to spot recurring problems and fix them in skills, plugins or deterministic checks

  • Own evaluations that show whether changes to skills and agents make them better

  • Work with engineers across disciplines to build useful tooling, assess new harness and model features, and retire what isn't used

  • Own the docs and onboarding that help engineers use the tooling effectively

What You Bring

  • A genuine passion for AI coding tools and agents, with hands-on experience building and maintaining skills, plugins, MCP integrations and other tooling that helps engineers get more from their tools and automates real work.

  • Hands-on software engineering experience, shipping and maintaining code that others depend on

  • Experience configuring, rolling out and maintaining shared developer tools, including safe handling of access, secrets and sensitive data

  • Experience deploying and managing Agents that improve the software delivery lifecycle

  • Strong scripting and automation skills, plus experience with Git, CI/CD and developer tooling

  • Experience evaluating AI workflows against real examples, understanding failure modes and improving results

  • Clear writing and collaboration skills, and comfort navigating a polyglot stack: Java, React and TypeScript, Python and Terraform on AWS

You Might Be a Fit if You

  • Fix the cause when you find yourself correcting the same thing twice, and prefer deterministic checks where possible

  • Care about developer experience and check whether a tool actually saves time

  • Enjoy helping colleagues get more from their tools through pairing, demos and docs

  • Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where ambiguity is the norm

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 

Role Overview

We're hiring a hands-on engineering manager for Harvey's Revenue Technology team. You'll bring software-engineering discipline to the systems our go-to-market organisation runs on, with Salesforce at the core and the CPQ, contracting, billing, marketing automation, revenue intelligence and post-sale platforms around it, and you'll put AI to work across that stack. You'll start as a player-coach: shipping yourself, setting the architecture and release practices for the system administrators and product owners already on the team, and hiring the engineers who come next. You'll be based in Dublin or London, with enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider team.

Harvey's go-to-market organisation is growing quickly, and this role owns the engineering practice behind its systems: how we design, build, test, release and monitor on Salesforce and the platforms around it, and the engineering standards across custom development, integrations and agents. The ideal candidate is a working manager: someone with hands-on Salesforce engineering and DevOps experience, who has led an engineering team and shipped AI agents that sellers actually use. Harvey builds AI for legal professionals; the internal bar has to match the external one.

At Harvey, we value Decisiveness, Simplicity, and the mindset that Job's Not Finished. We move fast, prioritize clarity, and are always striving for excellence. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do

  • Stay hands-on. Spend a meaningful share of your time in the work - designing systems, reviewing code, writing integrations, unblocking your engineers on production issues. You set the technical bar by demonstrating it.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM platform. Take responsibility for how Salesforce and the surrounding GTM systems fit together across lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle, including reliability, data integrity, security posture, and lifecycle. Decide where customisation belongs and where it doesn't.

  • Drive AI enablement into the business. Apply AI and automation to how our go-to-market teams work, with the evaluation and guardrail practices that make it safe, and drive adoption with the teams that use it.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, onboard, and develop the software engineers who join Revenue Technology, and set the architectural direction for the system administrators and product owners you work alongside. Own the interview loop, ramp plans, and performance for the engineering discipline.

  • Partner with business and systems owners. Work directly with Sales, Marketing Operations, Customer Success and Support, Deal Desk, Finance Systems and Enterprise Integrations to turn ambiguous business problems into scoped, sequenced engineering work, and to say no clearly when something shouldn't be built.

  • Establish engineering standards. Define how this team writes, tests, deploys, documents, and monitors what it builds. Introduce the practices that scale a growing team without adding process for its own sake.

  • Anchor Revenue Technology in EMEA. Provide senior technical presence in Dublin or London for a growing international sales organisation, and hold enough overlap with US stakeholders to stay tightly coupled to the wider org.

  • Make build-vs-buy calls. Assess when a business need is better solved by configuration, a vendor, an integration, custom code or an agent we build, and make that call with cost, security, and long-term maintenance in view.

 

What You Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on engineering on Salesforce-centred business systems, and experience leading engineers as a manager, tech lead or architect.

  • Salesforce engineering experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, integrations) and hands-on experience setting up Salesforce DevOps: source control, CI/CD, sandbox strategy and release management.

  • Hands-on engineering depth in a modern language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar) and real experience designing and operating API-based integrations between business systems.

  • Working knowledge of the GTM stack beyond the CRM (CPQ, marketing automation, revenue intelligence, support and customer-success platforms, contract and billing systems) and how lead-to-cash and the post-sale lifecycle actually flow across them.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping LLM-based agents or automations into production, outside a vendor's packaged agent product, with a clear point of view on evaluation, guardrails, and where the technology does and doesn't hold up.

  • Track record of hiring and developing engineers, and of raising the technical bar on a team you inherited or built.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and global environment.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience standing up an engineering practice inside a team that was previously admin- and configuration-led, or in a new office or region.

  • Background at a high-growth B2B SaaS company scaling through 2,000+ employees.

  • Hands-on work with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks, or LLM gateway and evaluation tooling.

  • Fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily working practice.

  • Experience with enterprise iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato) and event-driven integration patterns.

  • Exposure to legal, professional services, or another regulated industry.

Product Designer
raw.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing
 
Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.
 

We are looking for a talented Product Designer with a versatile skillset to join our team.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in crafting exceptional customer experiences, balancing user needs with business goals without sacrificing quality. We’re looking for a team player with a curious, self-driven mindset, who thrives in a fast-paced iterative environment with a high level of autonomy.

 

This role will be highly collaborative. You’ll work closely with fellow designers, developers, product managers and stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement, and proactively deliver solutions.

You will care about the whole customer experience, not only the UI. 


What you'll do...
  • Own improvements to our online buying experience for drivers.

  • Map out and optimise customer journeys to enhance user experience.

  • Design the full experience around each feature, not just the UI.

  • Run customer interviews and usability tests, ensuring what we build meets real customer needs.

  • Champion a customer-centric approach to design.

  • Collaborate with teams and business areas across the company.

  • Contribute to our design system and its maintenance.


    • What you'll need...

  • A minimum of 5 years professional design experience across responsive web design.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing your abilities: how you framed the problem, what research shaped your decisions, and what changed as a result.

  • Strong critical thinking. You question the brief and solve the right problem before you polish the solution.

  • Hands-on experience running customer interviews and usability tests.

  • High proficiency in Figma for design and prototyping.

  • Knowledge of design systems.

  • Experience working closely with developers and iterating together.

  • Experience using modern tooling, including AI, to accelerate time to value.

  • A self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment.

  • A curious personality, with high standards and attention to detail.

  • Confidence talking about your work with designers and non-designers alike.


    • Any of the following would be a bonus

  • Knowledge of prototyping in code with AI tools.

  • Digital illustration skills to help bring our expressive brand to life.

  • Animation skills.

  • Experience designing purchase or sign-up flows.

  • Experience designing for internal users or internal tools.


    • Why you'll love it here
  • Don't feel like you meet all of our hiring criteria? thats OK, apply anyway! we'd love to hear from you and have a conversation.
    •  
  • Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people 
    •  
  • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    •  
  • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
    •  
  • Just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we've taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies!
    • About us
     
    The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK. 
     
    We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a 'lease for life' through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.
     
    Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience. 
     
    We're an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.
     
    Please note we use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively.

    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

raw.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

About the role

To deliver on this mission, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Tech Flex team.

The Tech Flex team was established in early 2026, and has been growing strongly since then. The team is focused on greenfield opportunities at the cutting edge of Octopus' flexibility strategy, and aims to enable rapid response to opportunities, globally and across a wide range of domains. 

Time series forecasting is a critical capability across essentially all of our workstreams. Through this role, we aim to build a new capability within an already data-literate team. The intent is that this role will:

  • Act as an owner of time series forecasting expertise, and so will work across any project that has a forecasting component

  • Will not be explicitly limited to time series forecasting. Our team’s growth will continue to be dynamic, and so we expect this role to engage with backend engineering, data engineering, MLOps, machine learning, essentially to act as a ‘full stack data scientist’ with a specialisation on time series forecasting

We are building the next generation of products and tools to make energy more flexible. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. The team develops products that are used by millions of customers, helping boost renewables use and decarbonise energy systems worldwide.

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.

  • Establish greenfield forecasting systems upon the foundational layer of data engineering and warehousing that has been established in our own AWS environment(s)

  • Work closely with the centralised market forecasting team, extending their system to meet the needs of our platform

  • Interface with the established data warehouse, built on Databricks

raw.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality. 

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.

We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

Fund Management: This team looks at funds and the wider portfolio in a holistic way providing quality information to our investors.

About the role:

The role sits within the OEGEN’s Funds Finance team, reporting directly into a Senior Finance Manager. OEGEN Funds Finance are responsible for the financial reporting and analysis for an expanding portfolio of renewable assets that are owned by a number of Retail, Institutional and Listed Funds. These assets have a growing international presence across the UK, US, Europe, Australia and Asia. The team interacts with several other teams across OEGEN and its wider business, so it is imperative that this hire is able to build strong working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

You will be responsible for the delivery of the financial reporting and analysis across the portfolio. Whilst much of the day-to-day operations and accounting are outsourced, this role will be responsible for ensuring the quality of the management accounts and financial information produced at asset level and therefore will be required to spend time managing the performance of the external accounting teams. This will include supporting and improving information flows between teams, managing the quality of their outputs and establishing appropriate controls.

You will also be required to assist with new investment transactions, manage budgets and audits and delivery against them and also lead on ad hoc projects. 

This role is a 12-month FTC


What you'll do
  • Business partner for the fund-level finance team – ensuring delivery of information and service in line with the agreed Service Level Agreement.
  • Review and challenge management accounts provided by external accountants.
  • Report on the financial performance of the portfolios at monthly Customer Board meetings.
  • Deal with all queries – taking ownership of requests and issues, creating stakeholder goodwill by providing appropriate solutions in a timely manner.
  • Project manage the portfolio statutory audits; liaising with external auditors, external accountants and fund-level finance teams as required.
  • Project manage the annual budget process.
  • Review consolidated monthly management account information.
  • Review statutory financial statements and ensure all statutory filing requirements are met.
  • Prepare and review technical accounting papers for acquisitions, disposals, restructures and other significant transactions.
  • Support hedge accounting, impairment reviews and acquisition accounting.
  • Prepare and review cash flow forecasts and funding requirements.
  • Support banking covenant reporting and bank reporting requirements.
  • Oversee the review of key balance sheet reconciliations, including intercompany balances, shareholder loans, bank reconciliations, fixed assets, provisions and other significant balance sheet items.
  • Manage payment approvals as appropriate.
  • Ensure a robust control environment is present throughout the portfolio. This could involve insisting on the utilisation of OEGEN’s systems for new assets/projects.
  • Be a valued business partner and build and maintain good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Identify system improvements and take ownership of driving change across the team. This will involve working closely with external accountants to improve current processes across the portfolio.
  • Ad hoc project work as required.

    • What you'll need
  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA) with at least 3 years post qualification experience (preferably gained in a relevant role).
  • Good technical knowledge of UK GAAP.
  • Experience of complex consolidations and acquisition accounting.
